To be honest it's a decent Dragon Ball Z game but that being said it doesn't have half of the excitement of any actual good DBZ games due to all the constant A-I command reads (ruling the match/one sided), the demanding soul boost level up system, the constant delays of attacks in game and the lack of fighting stages and character costumes, if you thought that was it; just wait, there's more. The game's summoning system to obtain fighters is a complete let down especially if you run out of chrono crystals, even if you end up spending any money on this game your chances of getting new characters are "paper thin" not to mention how often the supposed to be randomized system keeps generating the same fighters you already have multiple times in a row. It would be nice to be able to sell and or trade characters in game that you don't want and or play with but I guess that would make too much sense. (MONEY PIT) The most heartwrenching part of this game is the event specific characters that you may never have a chance to get again after an event ends,(don't get me started on how insanely impossible it is to get these characters once they're patched into the game, if you get them at all.) the poor voice overs, the repetitive battle grunts, and the handicap feel of gameplay; If you are a fan of the new Dragon Ball Super then this might be right up your alley but for all my old school DBZ fans I can safely say; "Let the nit picking begin." Overall it is not a bad game to play and pass the time however it could be a lot better if it had a few tweaks to the problems mentioned earlier. *To the development crew, this game is very sloppy on your parts and you all should feel kinda bad for publishing a broken game just for the money and taking advantage of the gaming community.* If this game maybe had a few beam-clashes and a couple of quick time events during combat just to recreate the old school combat style of what Dragon Ball Z games should have and or had, it might take some of the pain away.

Sadly after you beat the story mode, Chrono crystals are hard to find but atleast the new players can get some pretty good fighters. [Really good game and I recommend downloading it, you'll have fun]

For the developers, can we get a feature for our inventory/item menu that explains what inventory holds what? I can't receive the daily present because my inventory is full/maxed out, but I don't know which inventory it falls under to clear out some space. For example, you have a separate inventory for souls and a separate one for training items. I don't see anything to tell me where an adventure ticket is kept. (Adventure slot key being the present). So I'm unable to accept it.

First of all a few good things: - love the game design - love the quality of the game - mechanics are good - there's alot to do ingame such as events etc. Things that have been bugging me: - I sometimes experience severe lag even tho I have good connection (I was located in the middle of town) - There should be a way to 'Block' certain attacks, not just vanishing step. - My game crashed twice in PvP. overall I love the game, I even started watching the anime because I wanted to know more.

I have been playing this game since it's release. You collect characters from the dragon ball universe, make teams from the characters and fight battles and challenges in a Tenkaichi style. The game is very fun to play especially when you get the characters you want. Many new modes and additions have been added to the game since then. The graphics are amazing and the game is great for a mobile game.

Love the game, feels rushed tho, not a large enough character roster right now, want more stories and more customization like a console dbz game . I know the team can do it , game is great . Almost perfect but dodging is iffyoff sometimes . Would be nice if there was a block/gaurd button . And the elemental advantage aspect is kinda hard to understand, as with character specific abilities. +20% to tag? Some parts are confising

I like playing the game, although I don't like things like, it freezing on me, or me me clicking in between the cards resulting in tap punching, those should be fixed. The infamous green card glitch where you use a green card and it auto attacks, tap attacks for you can also do with some work. The Team is very responsive and we can see they're doing their best, they are human, I give them A for effort any day of the week even if they can't perform as good as we'd like to, they do work hard.

Honestly one of the best gacha-style games out there! There's so much variety in what you can have on your team, and even casual players can enjoy this game, as it can be really easy to grind and max out characters. The only problem I have is how limited the souls are. While I do like playing the game, I don't like when every time I get a new character I know I have to grind a bunch of the event stages just to get the souls needed to soul boost said character. Other than that, amazing game.

The game is good. it's really good, wasn't expecting a phone game to have a lot of thought put into it. But the one huge problem for this game, if your gonna have summons fix the % of rare characters and actually give out a good number of crystals rather than single digit crystals. if this doesn't get fixed, then the game is pay to win and won't be worth in the long run with them adding more insane characters by the second with a literal 1% to a 0.0625% to get. It is now pay to win

I am a big Dragon Ball fan and I love this game. The art style is very similar to it's anime counterpart. However getting chrono crystals is very hard if you're not paying, which btw is a lot, otherwise there's a lot of grind involved if you aren't willing to pay. Also, most of the summons are ridiculous even after spending 1000s Chrono crystals you end up with weak hero or extreme characters not a single sparking.

The free-to-play has gotten a lot better in recent months. I like the gauntlets that they're doing that give you Zenkais and Chrono Crystals. Getting enough CC to be able to do summons is much quicker and easier than it used to be. The PvP seems to have improved as well. Not as much lag as there used to be. Not getting too lucky with the summons and getting the new characters that have been coming out recently, but I guess that's just me.

It's a fun game, but there are a few things holding it back. For one, the game is very grind heavy. This wouldn't be a big issue if the story mode didn't require more and more of your attention as you progress. Other options for gaining the summoning currency are very limited, and from what I can tell the only other option is grinding events. Secondly, pvp feels like it relies less on player skill and more on what characters you have. The better the character, the more likely you are to win.

Great game in general. I haven't spent any money and I still really enjoy it and i am able to get most of the characters. Not huge on the pvp but the events and story mode are fun. Sometimes events are a bit too reliant on specific characters but usually they will come back around later if you don't get to finish them the first time around. Character progression system is pretty good. Older characters(in most cases) don't hold up against new ones but are still fun to collect. So nostalgic!

This game does not like the players who work for there chrono crystals. I haven't gotten an ultra in 2 years and I'm still getting shafted on the ultra summons. I think dragonball legends should give people the units they have been trying for in there gift box. Like a present. like "we know you've been summoning for a long time, so, here's the character for all of your hard work!"you Know? I don't know. Maybe it's a bad idea.

Terrible net code/matchmaking makes the game unplayable way too often. Characters, animations, and stories are all very high quality and interesting, but those are just about the only redeeming qualities. Typical gacha game, only reason to play is for new characters. If you don't get them, just uninstall. The balancing is non existant, almost the worst out of any game I've ever played. If the game had fewer connectivity issues, less powercreep, and a better pity system, this would be 5 stars.

This game is very fun. The gameplay is not like anything else, and the graphics is a great part of it too. I would love to see improvements made such as adding more mechanics to the game. It's such a great game, but what if you added Ultra Instinct Goku? I believe his main ability would be a Ultimate Move combined with a ability that let's him dodge any and all attacks for 10 seconds or less in order to use the ultimate attack. But that's just my thoughts. Anywho, overall it's a great game.

This game is very addictive. Upgrading your Characters and getting new Sparking characters is the best part. Crystal's are hard to come by they pretty much try to make you buy them. The game is always upgrading and alot of the time I cant login and play. But when everything is up and running I can playing for hours. I love this game.

Great graphics, good story and development for characters, particularly in the beginning with Nappa which actually made me like him more. (At least this version of him lol) As of late, the summoning rates aren't too good and since the story is released in segments and the events (Like the Raditz, Vegeta, etc.) last too long, it makes it harder for a FTP player to get crystals. That being said, it's still a solid game. Wish the main story would come out more often though, it's really interesting.

I've had this game for a while now and have no complaints other than the lag switchers in ranked pvp. But I am having problems loading into the game right now. It keeps telling me there is a new version in the app store. I've conepleatly uninstalled and reinstalled the game and still getting this issue. If it wasn't for these isues I'd give 5 stars as it's the only phone game I play and I love it.

Amazing game with tons of content. The graphics and fighting controls are great for a mobile game. Best of all you can play and enjoy the game without spending any money. Edit: drop rates for new characters have changed for the worse. After several months of playing daily and using thousands of crystals on summons I have acquired 1 newly released character. One of the main ways the game kept me coming back was the new characters and changes in play. Hard to stay interested with the new rates.

I love dragon ball legends. It's a Really fun game and the events are always fun to play. There is one update that I think a lot of us would like to see. There should be a way to exchange unwanted characters for maybe Chrystals or tickets. Heros are cool and its cool to have them, but in the PvP world they don't do much damage. there's many characters that are being overlooked daily, simply because we don't want them (: I think a lot of us would appreciate this update!

For a mobile fighting game I think Legends took one of the better routes to making it fun. Edit: 2 years on and my original review holds up. It's gotten a lot more friendly with it's resources. Edit 2: They've gotten a bit less Free to Play Friendly as of late, forcing you to the super challenging end of event fights before you earn any Chrono Crystals instead of giving them out every 5 or 10 event battles, or requiring you to limit break a character to 1+ before rewards are given.

Very good game. I've been playing it for 2 years. The amount of features and characters is nice. But there is one problem... trying to get Chrono crystals is getting harder and harder, and the amount of banners is overwhelming. Please give us more officiant ways to get cc. Even when I get 1k cc to do a summon, I do it and then I have to grind for about another hour or two, even THREE. The game is good but please help us getting what we want.

If you're a Dragon Ball fan this is a must have mobile game in my opinion. Plenty of story content if that's your thing, and if PvP is more your style there's plenty of that too. Sure it has some issues, you have your cheaters just like anywhere else, but they've been working on trying to fix that. Over all with really good graphics, and new content and characters added regularly its definitely worth giving it a shot.

The character art in this game is on another level. They all look incredible. The gameplay is simple and fun. Although, even though it has microtransactions they give you plenty of the currency for free just by playing the game so you don't have to buy to begin with. There's plenty to grind so I'm always pulled back in. Great game for dragon ball fans.

It's gotten better but I still have some problems with the game. The gameplay is good, some issues with inputs. PvP was my favorite mode but it's riddled with problems. The problems include lag, advantage if you spend money, and Rising Rush. Do be cautious about spending money for more of the game's currency if you aren't good with your money.

A very fun game, good graphics and summoning is very addictive. Pay to play players might have a slight advantage, but you don't need to go online, the base game is very fun. Should have a better balancing system, as the newest characters are always the ones on top,in multiplayer and you rarely ever see non saiyan teams, but maybe in some time that will fix itself. Overall a fun game to play, recommended to fans of the anime and its fighting games.

The game looks pretty good for a mobile game and that intro animated scene is freaking awesome haha. **1 Year Later** The game is still a very fun game to play however the push to make you spend money to purchase in game "Crystals" is really draining and can often make me not want to play anymore. I used to have 5 friends who would play this game too, which was the best part because we would always compare units and strength. They all deleted the game due the need F2P just not working anymore.

Gradually becoming less and less generous/consumer friendly and steering more towards becoming nothing but a cash grab. This is to be expected with games like this, but they seem to be picking up the pace, and doing it quite rapidly now.I liked the game when I started, around January, but it's not going in a good direction. I wouldn't recommend this to anyone right now, and it's trending to become even worse. The model for games like these are designed to get you hooked by being very generous initially, and then gradually become less so, hoping that you spend money later on to keep up after you have become hooked. If you have kids, don't let them play these gacha games.

The game is great, it's very fun at times and getting into it isn't hard at all, I think it'd be better if the rewards for completing challenges and the like were better. For example, we could lower the price required to summon, or we could get more free to play friendly options for people who don't spend money on this game. I like the new changes, and the devs are super responsive, even fixing a problem we had mere days after we made it known.

Game is great. Includes almost the entire DB lore with more characters to release still. Unfortunately game has a heavy "pay-wall" where there just isn't enough Chrono Crystals on offer for people who play without spending money, or who can't spend money. Event's went from 1k to 300/500 on offer. Hate how new Banners are used to make "Events" easier to beat, but summonings for these characters are out of reach. Not a bad game, just difficult for Free2Play

It could be so much better. You have so many multiples of the same characters to where a majority of the characters are redundant. Why are there four/five different Galdo or Chiatzou? The tutorials are brain numbing, unavoidable, and much longer than the gameplay. After about a month of playing and summoning fighters you will finally have a sense of "feeling ready to actually play the game." When you see the micro leveling system you'll know what I'm talking about, good luck. RIP Akira Toriyama

It's fun to play, if you can dedicate daily hours to it. Its drop rates for characters is a 6 out of 10. This means a lot of grinding and even more ,miracle luck to get your desired character. But hey remember it's just a game. You can spend money on it or not. I personally don't, and still get great characters. It is increasingly harder on free to play players recently.

I've been playing this game since it was released back in May. I, like many other players from the beginning, thought this game had so much potential so looked forward to the updates that would fix glitches and propel the gameplay forward. However, an over exploitation of the side step technique as well as cheating PVP players (which now dominates that section of the game) render this almost unplayable due to the unfair practices of others. I sincerely hope the producers of this game take a hard and total look at the pitfall with this component and make a drastic change before other dedicated players jump ship as well.

This game is wayyyy too P2W (Pay to win). There are some of the events that are hard enough to do without trying to make you spend money on the game. The chrono crystals are pretty hard to get if you're a free to play type of person and summoning on it requires 1,000 of them. When I do PvP most of the time I go against tons of whales (people that spend hundreds of dollars on the game) and I can almost never win. Even with rising rush it's nearly impossible to beat their tanky characters. From almost every aspect of the game it's pay to win and the prices aren't that impressive either. Their chrono crystal prices and over the top in terms of equality for product.

This game is pretty amazing. The animations, card art and the voice lines are pretty cool. There is also a game mode which introduces you to all the mechanics and moves so it'll be pretty easy for you to get used to the game. The units are pretty balanced and the gameplay is amazing. It's pretty easy to get ingame currency so you don't have to spend money on it all the time. The newest unit is Ultra Super Saiyan 4 Vegeta. He looks amazing and I am really hoping to get him once I summon on him🥳

I would give 5 stars but there are some fairly large issues I have with the game. For a very long time there was a lack of PvE content. As the game goes on, the developers are adding more PvE content but it's a little too scattered and spaced out. There's also not much to do with the stuff they do release. My last big issue is how PvP is handled. Staying relevant requires you to have the best units at all times. It's just not possible for the average player.

Best game I have played yet for the Android OS! The gameplay is incredibly close to the console game, Budokai Tenkaichi, of which i was also addicted to playing. But now I can take it everywhere with me since this one was released. I only wish the characters were a little easier to unlock without having to pay cash to get them. Again, greatest game on the Android OS. I am looking forward to updates and adding new characters in the near future

Honestly, it started great! Lots of free stuff, reasonable sumoning rates and quantity of units on the banners. Almost no problems with gameplay, but then... One year later I must admit. Not looking so great. Bandai doesn't listen well to the player base. Huge prices for crystals. Crazy low chances of getting a featured unit. Always mixed with a load of old units that we don't want. Issues with PvP. One year ago I gave this a 5 star and high praisings. Now I'm thinking if I'll dropping the game.

I'm immediately impressed by the graphics. The gameplay itself is simple to grasp and fun. The game runs smoothly. With this being free to play, I always worry about in-game purchases and how invasive it may be, however, I feel you earn a good amount of Crystal's and plenty of ways to earn them. For a free to play DBZ title, this is handled very well.

Great game at first but it is actually extremely confusing for new players. It is always strange to me why for some games you have to read lengthy tutorial only to be able to understand the game. Even now I don't know what are the different types of zenkai aweakaning. And the community and the developers are not there to answer any question. The other thing that I don't like is the lack of block in the battles - it just doesn't feel right in dbz fight.

This is a really fun game. A lot to do. PvE, PvP, new content every month. It is a gatcha game. Rates are pretty low, but I've been pretty lucky. My biggest issue is how expensive in game currency is to buy. I play another very high profile get and it's cost is about 1/3 less with rates way higher and it's still a top grosser for 8 years. I believe your player base would spend more if the rates were a bit better or currency cost less, or preferably, both. If that issue was fixed it's be 5*.

Great graphics and mechanics. It's hard to believe this is a mobile game. Nostalgic and exciting for any dragonball fan Update as of version 1.31: Game quality has dropped pretty severely over time. Where they used to be very giving with in game currency, there is much less to be earned now. Worse yet, when you do have enough to spend, the rates at which you're likely to earn a good unit have been reduced greatly, making it difficult to be competitive without spending big $.

Changed to a 3 star rating. Still see ppl cheating during p.v.p The Game play is great. Story line is great. Story line achievements are little convoluted (i.e) you might have too do the same mission twice to clear. Because it doesn't follow the 3 the character parameter. Energy fill rate is a bit slow having to wait 15 min per energy bar is a bit much. The in game store is a bit expensive. but if you got the money be my guest. But all in all it's a good game

I like how it put a lot of characters in the game and the events,story line,and the summons. This is a really fun game. But I have one issue. The game can get laggy sometimes. And when I do a summon I sometimes get kicked out of the game during the summon and I lost 1000 gems and I never know who I got if it was a unit I already got. I hope they can fix this. EDIT: Its been a while sinve I made this review and most of these bugs are still happening

While the core gameplay is fun, I cannot leave a higher review until they do something about the summoning system. there is a level frustration in spending 1,000 Gems (about $20 real world) to only summon the lowest level rarity characters. due to this i cannot and will not justify spending any of my money in this game and I advise you dont either.

Such a great game to play. Totally love it and it has almost every character in the dragon ball lore including a brand new on (Shallot: he's a sayain to) he is also voiced by the youtuber Kaggyfilms. love the character and love the game, period, point blank! However over the years it has gone down hill and gave more power to those that pay to play, along with horrible drop rates on newer units.

The game isn't bad overall but there is a definite pay-to-play aspect to it. They want you to buy the crystals to do the summons but the crystal packs are ridiculously expensive for a casual player and the drop rate for characters you want is pretty much abysmal these days. There are also challenges that are almost impossible to do because you cant compete with what you summon, nor can you reach the 2400 power level needed.

Great game and all except for two things. First of all, summon rates on certain characters is outragous. For example, you can spend 15k crystals on one banner and not get the character you're aiming for once. Also if you are f2p, then pvp isnt for you. The zenkais have completely ruined that mode. Other than that the story mode is pretty cool, there is a great amount of characters to use, and there is also a good amount of events too. If the zenkais weren't so game breaking this would be a 4/5.

Great game, great graphics, great features. Some of them were on the more forgettable side though. The only complaint I have and the reason I gave this game 4 stars is because of the terrible gacha mechanics. The rates of which you pull good characters is incredibly low. Most is about a 1 percent chance. There are also 0.25 percent characters too. If you are a pay to play player, then this game is a must play. But it can be very enjoyable if you are free to play too.

I have returned to the game after a long time and I'm sad to see how much pay to win the game has become. you need to add money for everything and the CCs are too expensive for a mobile game i mean they could at least increase the amount of CCs we get from every purchase because now if you can't afford to add money you must grind for hours. And if they want keep the prices as they are now then fix the char rates. 0.35 for an ultra just great

I'll just list some reasons for my 5* review. 1.so many characters to find 2. you can upgrade your characters to become super powerful. 3.Lots of hard to find SP characters available when you summon.You don't always get the best people but when you do its a great feeling. 4. The graphics look great as well as the sound. 5.Its easy to acquire gems for summons.Just play and do the daily missions and daily login and you won't have any problems. I haven't paid for a single thing and have over 4000.

being a player since 2018, I love this game. To put it short this is the ideal moblie dbz game. they have the characters, nice graphics, nice mechanics, but there is one thing i wish was added. A pity system. some of us players spent, and im even joking 20+ thousand cc and never get the banner unit, so maybe after a certain amount of time it will give the banner UNIT to you not both, just one of your choice.

Definitely the best mobile dragon ball game out. Definitely has flaws but still a great game, especially for the single player experience. The Story and co-op modes are fun and events always keep you grinding for the next characters. I personally wouldnt spend money on the paid currency as it's EXTREMELY overpriced and not worth it. If you're casual with it, you will love it. If you go into PvP to be competitive be prepared to drop thousands on the game to keep up with the pay 2 win players.

This game has brought me countless hours of enjoyment. Every day I find the need to log in and collect the rewards and have fun with the gameplay. They are also very lenient on how many Chrono crystals you get so it's not pay to win. I've been play for almost 400 days now and I haven't spent money on it until the newest summon. In all I recommend this game very much

Awesome game. Fighting mechanics have a lot potential for a mobile game, in addition to the vast amount of characters that you have at your disposal. Although the game does seem to be pay-to-win, the rating system allows players to take on equally ranked players, taking in both ability and team strength into consideration. Their are dozens of ways to obtain CC (Chrono Crystals, the main currency), and the game is always updating, which focus on bettering the gaming experience for all players.

Hi, I'm actually coming to rate this because I had a question. But first, this is a great game, one of the best if not the best mobile game. Than you guys (the creator[s] and developer[s]) for making such a great game I love it, the voices, the story, the characters, the antagonists and protagonists. Unbelievable how good a simple not so simple mobile game is. But now for my question. (I HAD TO TELL YOU HOW GREAT A GAME DB LEGENDS IS) Would it be possible to consider 🤔💭 giving the option to sell characters that you wouldn't want? Such as HERO's for zeni or Chrono Crystals or items, or something like that. That would be fantastic! I imagine everyone would appreciate that. But if this isn't possible to do or you don't even read this. Thanks anyways! Great game...

This is a good DB experience, the cutscenes for ultra rarity characters, the fight scenes, and much more! Although, there is one thing that I don't like about this game is the fact that the bosses, Such as SSJ4 Goku and Vegeta,(for ultra omega shenron) they are hard to defeat and I lose the matches every minute. That's why my rating for the game is a 4/5.

Amazing game with awesome story and great characters. Only problem is now it is impossible to get any characters. The drop rates are basically non existant so good luck getting any good characters without dropping a ton of money. Which I confirmed today by trying one more time. Guess what. No new characters. Just the same ones. And from the special drop no less. Dont play this game till they realize that this is stuipid. I cant even get sparkling characters from guaranteed drops.

Dragon Ball Legends feels a lot like Xenoverse in your pocket. It is by far the most fun mobile game I've ever played. The battle animations and the 3D models in general look incredible, Shallot is a great character design, PvP is fast and fun, summons are very fair. If you're a Dragon Ball fan and you're not playing DB Legends, you're making a huge mistake.

Amazing game, but to get the new characters coming into the game. It wants you to put over $50 in the game for even having a good chance of obtaining them. Had to uninstall recently because I was excited about a new character pack, paid for 1of the deals in the shop for 28.99 and got nothing. It is all supposed to be random and up to chance but theres times where you won't pull a good character for a few weeks. If you don't have money to pour into the game, good luck on getting new characters.

This game is cool and all, but I began to lose interest after playing it for a while. The reason why I lost interest is due to the lack of character variety. There are so many other characters people would love to see in Dragon Ball Legends, but it takes so long for that to happen, whereas compared to Dokkan Battle, the game gets new characters very often.

This game is amazing, this was always a part of my childhood life, it will always be five stars to me, but let me give some advice, 1. my internet is fine and ny storage is almost empty, the game can sometimes be laggy, you should probably fix that 2. Although there is lots of cool content, its not what it used to be, some people and I really miss the cool events, please bring them back -Your most loyal downloader

Great gameplay marred by greedy business decisions. Many things that used to be free are now locked behind premium currency. The store prices for premium currency are absurdly high (even on sale it's still high). You can earn it in-game, but you need to save up so much in order to get your units to decent strength. Worse, there's a cash-only currency that makes the game extremely pay-to-win. PvP used to be fun, but now people use strategies that are almost impossible to counter.

86 hours on the game. Can safely say the game is very much P2W, if you don't get a character to at least 5 star and good equipments, your damage and defense will be so bad that you can't even survive for more than 2 minutes in ranked Gold and higher games. Some units are so OP that their kit alone can win games! Absolutely a P2W game! Plus, the in-game store is too overpriced. Like who wants to pay 40 dollar to summon 2 times that doesn't even guarantee you a sparkling unit?

This game is certainly more fun than I could have anticipated. It adds another way for me to get a Dragonball fix on mobile besides Dokkan. I am a long time Dragonball fan and love the game. Controls are easy to pick up. Graphics and gameplay are surprisingly good. Summon rates are pretty decent. The store however is maybe a little lopsided/expensive.

This game is nothing but a huge cash grab, the draw rates are so low for older players unless you create multiple accounts or are a new player. You can waste over 8000 in-game currency and never receive the unit you wanted until 6 months later. Not to mention the shop prices are high as hell, and this is mainly pay to win. I honestly tried getting back into this but now I'm losing interest again and let this be a warning to new players, do not play unless you have very deep pockets to do so. 👎

I have an amazing time with the game. The game modes are fun but also feel like they're to heavily based around the new characters. For people who are free to play and have been playing for a while CC aren't very easy to come by when these new banners come out. With the addition of Ultra Characters and their banners being very limited time, their rates being so low its hard to pull them. I love this game, I won't lie it's got me hooked and I have a blast.

This game is absolutely insane. It's graphics are so incredibly good, the gameplay is pretty easy when you know what you are doing. (Using strike art and going up and sidestepping to gain 4-5 ki) Also, the characters are so incredibly good when you have them, when you don't, then... you're dead. The only thing I don't like about Dragon Ball Legends is that it's pay to win (P2W.) If it weren't P2W, then I would definitely give it a 5 star rating. (P.S. I just got Gogeta Blue which is insane!)

The only game I continually play for years. I've been through them all. This game is just the most polished game out there, and though it can be p2w, you don't need to shell out bucks. There are plenty of ways to get characters, all you have to do is stick with it. Edit: sadly the devs keep crapping in our eyes and are running this game to the ground. Hopefully we can turn this train around, but that's doubtful. Lots and lots of greed.

Great game! Love the story and the animation is unreal. If you're a Dragon Ball fan, I highly recommend getting into this and experiencing all the characters unique abilities. This game has evolved since its release, in a way that they have made it more efficient with basically everything! Its developed in a way for new people to come in and get straight into the action and feeling like they aren't to far behind. Only problem, I would say is that the gems cost way to much and the pull rates.

I DO love this game but... If you decide to play this game for a long period of time, you will most likely be nudged towards spending money. You can most definitely play for free, but that GRIND IS REAL. I don't mind spending some cash because of all the time I have put into the game. If you are a DBZ fan, check it out. Dokkan is dope too (more grind, but dope animations)

I love this game. The story with Shallot is cool and unique. The rates on the banners are really good and the prices on Chrono Crystals are really good. Pvp is an awesome option to play and it gives you something to do when you are done with the events. They make the events difficult but not so difficult that it is impossible. My one issue is many of the events are released in parts, so you get the chrono crystals from it after the prime of the banner 999.

This game is really good. The controls are really simple and the graphics are amazing. The only complaints I have are the fact that , during PvP, you can end up fighting someone who is 10 time stronger than you rather than someone of equal power. Also, it really annoys me when I spend so much time collecting Chrono Crystals or tickets for summons, but then all I get is extreme or hero characters and not 1 sparking. To wrap this up, are there gonna be any more parts to story mode?

Like most mobile games you'll come across, there is a pay to win aspect, but with that being said, this game is extremely generous. I have 6 SP(SP is the highest rarity) characters, fully maxed out, have had no trouble in story mode, or ranked, and have yet to spend a dime on this game. The controls are very interactive and the story mode is very interesting. I will definitely be making a purchase in the shop because I like supporting games like this one. The provide you with everything you need without feeling like you need to spend money to have the best things. As a long time gamer and DBZ fan, this game was right up my alley.

Love this game, but the in game purchases are insane. The amount of chrono crystals you get aren't worth a fraction of the money you're asked to spend. And even then, good luck actually getting the summons you want. The summon rates are so low. I've recently spent over 20,000 chrono crystals on different summons and I have nothing to show for it. And that's a small amount to some players. And that was gathered over time, not purchased. You'd have the same luck as me, but you'd be 80 dollars out.

It's impossible to keep up anymore as a f2p. They are pretty stingy in terms of free Chrono Crystals(the premium currency),plus the grind for the scraps they do give you just isnt worth it. The gameplay itself is good, but that's about as far as it goes. I've played other gacha games that are much more generous in terms of rewards for active players, like tickets you could grind out to get basically any character, plus DB Legends has terrible rates for their banners, just too predatory anymore.

Excellent game honestly! Great job on the animations and graphics . I truly do love the game but...it has it's up's and downs especially when it comes towards the PvP mode. It's struggle some time to time with the the game lagging or it takes you a couple of "buisness day's" to attack. I'd prefer it to Match players up with people that are the same rank as you or fights the same way as you. Further on great job of maintaining the game. Keep it up!

I spent 4+ years playing this game every single day. Spent 0 money on it and still felt strong enough to beat almost all enemies. I loved the game a lot. With it's cool units, nice animations and fights. It always kept me entertained. This is all past tense only due to the fact that I just lost all my data with it deleting itself from my game and not having it connected to my account. I hope you can enjoy it ad much as I did.

Amazing game but can you please make it where we can exchange the old characters for crystals or something? The low tier characters just sit there and they're never used. Also there isn't enough information on how to use all of the gold and other rewards so they also just pile up. The game play is great!!!! But the info just isn't there.

The game is pretty good, I like the story mode and the way PvP works, as well as the Co-Op aspect of the game. The only thing I dislike really are the summon rates, like everyone else has mentioned, the summon rates are quite harsh, especially the characters with the rarity known as "Ultra", they are quite harsh on the players, and after some time, getting Chrono Crystals get quite difficult, but overall the is excellent.

Decent game, the graphics are really good and it is fun play while killing some time. The animations are top notch and the art is amazing, the only downside to this game is that it is not f2p friendly, this does not allow players who do not want to spend money to get the really strong characters easily, the spawn rates for each character are too low. I hope they change this or this will be a push factor for many free-to-play players

I started playing Dragon Ball Legend during the anniversary and at first it seemed good. I enjoyed the matches and collected a lot of CC. But the more you play, the more you realize it's just money-minded. Progress slows down and everything pushes you to spend real money. It quickly stops being fun. Dragon Ball Legend is not a good game, just a cash grab."👎

Brilliant game. I usually don't mind myself touching mobile games because of their unpolished gameplay, and lack in visuals. Though, I was hooked the moment I started playing, and have gotten far despite not making a single transaction. The only thing stopping this game from being 5 star for me is the fact that people who pay for crystals have a VERY clear advantage... Otherwise, I would argue this is the best Dragon Ball mobile game, and very possibly up there with the best Dragon Ball games.

So the game is good but only to an extent. Now don't get me wrong this game is super fun but, it gets to a point where achieving gems gets difficult especially when the % to get a "super" character is highly low. Like it almost feels like a pay to win game at times. Everything else is awesome and fun! Although people who have overpowering character(s) shouldn't be able to fight some one way weaker in pvp it should even rated pvp.

God tier game. But, there is just one thing that could make it better. What if there was a mode in the game that allowed you to free play against a character who had infinite health? Then, it could attack you but you wouldn't take any damage. That would be good for using a new cover change, dodging for ultra instinct units, and lastly, for those green card thingies. Besids, at least you would get to practice your pvp skills with them. Other than that, the game is great in almost every other way.

This is a stellar game. I wish the battling had a little less "Card Clicking" for attacks but i understand that mobile gaming formats can only provide so many different options. With that in mind, this is the Dragon Ball Z game I've been waiting for. The variety of heroes stretches so far. Thank you Bandai-Namco! Also I haven't experienced many of the problems I see or hear other players have experienced. it's not the game guys. Check your phone or connection.

The only thing I do have with this issue, even though it's a great game is sometimes when I spend my crystal endgame currency to get new characters it would never load in. Which causes me to lose my crystals. This isn't fair, and hopefully there's a fix for this since I work hard and I grind hard to get what I need to get. And losing them is like a slap in the face.

Been able to play the game since they fixed the S24+ issue. I was reminded why I love this game, but why I also hate it. The game has fun mechanics and cool characters, even balanced ones. But then there are characters like Ultra Super Saiyan 2 Gohan(Youth) who completely ruin the games balance and fun for those who don't spend the money to buy more CC. I understand it's a gacha game and this is how gacha games work, but sometimes, it's a little too much. Game is annoying at times, but also good
fun and entertaining.The story mode is amazing,the characters are cool and the anniversary is awesome

I am loving this game, definitely worth the 800mb+. But a problem I have is that the tutorial is making the gameplay way too restrictive, essentially half an hour of just 'do this do that', so for a while I was contemplating of just deleting the game.. And another thing is when you try to dodge, it's a bit slow. And apparently you can't dodge the ki blasts cause they just turn 90 degrees at the last second. But otherwise it's an awesome game.

Epic game for sure. Graphics are phenomenal for a "Phone-Game". However, it does take up an obseen amount of data. With constant upgrades (you're forced to download if you want to play) the game has a serious problem with crashing. More often than not, it's while in the middle of a battle. Quite the annoyance. So, other than the frequent crashes, it IS an amazing game!

My review toward the game play still is valid, however I had my phone reset, and even though I had a backup, I couldn't restore my game. after a long period of emailing, I couldn't get my data back, which means I lost a lot of time and effort. It's a great game that follows how a lot of the tenkaiichi games play. The only thing I could say against it is that due to lag the game doesn't always pick up dodges and such as it should, creating openings, but this just tests your skill.

This game is actually pretty fun. I've been playing for a few days now and it's been pretty responsive with the controls. The graphics are really nice (I play on a LG Rebel 4 LTE). As a fan of the Dragon Ball universe for over 30 years I have to say that this is really awesome! The only downside is that every so often the screen blacks out at the start of a battle. Does the game have in app purchases? Yes. But it doesn't force it on you. You can progress without paying a cent. Get it now!

Almost every year or so this game gets better and better, it's really fun. If I had to pick out a few negatives it'd probably be the amount of updates, but then again that's what makes the game better. Of course there are things like grinding and upgrading equipment. I only level up the characters, not so much the equipment, and am finding myself perfectly fine. Other than that, this game is great, I've had it since day one of release.

I love the Dragon Ball series, so a game like this with fun and unique battles is really cool! A few small warnings, though. 1) New or recent characters are a requirement a majority of the time in the upper ranks, as they are really strong and annoying to fight. 2) It is hard to get good characters, as it requires a lot of grinding and luck. 3) Proper team building is time consuming and takes a lot of resources. I've played for a while, and I would still recommend it to any DB fan regardless! 🔥

I love this game but I literally can't get anymore Chrono crystals. It's the same with almost every free to play player. Once you finish soul boosting and story it's over. They could also make the deals better. Like imagine looking at shop to see 1000 cc for like 14$ and 2000 for like 40$ the deals are only good during special occasions. Plus every player that has money to spend gets all the good characters meanwhile I'm stuck with sparking Goku☠️. I'm gonna spend a bit of money then that's it

Updating my review after the latest update - they removed the only gameplay mechanic that made high level AI possible to defeat (even with boost characters in some cases), reduced a lot of in game currency rewards, and this is all after a while of setting a standard of needing new chase units for most new events. I do like this game, but with these changes, PvE is insufferable. PvP was already insufferable, but I could do 1-2 matches for the rewards, but those have been reduced now too.

This game has been the most prolonged time in my phone just because of how amazing it is..... Graphically stunning and gameplay wise it has just left me speechless from the very first time I downloaded it. If beginners who don't know how to play the game, don't worry as it wasn't an issue for me to get used to the game and personally I am a slow person in terms of getting used to things

Love it. Get to play as all your favorite and legendary characters to even your least favorite characters! Some of the mechanics feel frustrating and often feel as if they should work, but nontheless dogdging and countering people in PvP is highly rewarding and satisfying. Overall, fun game to contiounsly grow stronger. Definitely one of the strongest games on the Play Store.

Overall, as a Dragon Ball fan, I have a lot of fun with this game. I get excited when new events and character units are added, but that is also why I am not giving it a full 5 stars. New units seem to have drop rates so rare, that I've seen people spend over 8k Chrono Crystals (In game currency) to get the new characters they want. And while I agree that the drop rates shouldn't be over frequent, making it easy, I can say that the rates need to find a fair balance. Grinding is not awarded.

The game is almost perfect and the devs totally nailed gameplay, graphics, controls, rewards, f2p friendliness and a lot of other things...but the one thing that i would say needs a complete Rework is the game's equipment system it is much too complicated, especially for players who are new to the Gatcha/Rpg genre and also the availability of equipments is too tight. And as much of the mid-end game depends solely on the catalog of equipments in the player possession i'm going to give it 4 stars.

I have a suggestion for the team behind the game. You need to put an exit/back button on Searching for Opponent screen in PvP mode, because sometimes it takes forever to search for an opponent. And we cannot navigate back. So we have to exit the game and start again in order to exit the searching for opponent screen. Hope the team will look after this

Well after two years of this game and the anniversary closing up, I thought it would be a good time to update my review the game has come along way since its launch and still holds strong there's enough content to keep new players for a long time and old ones returning, it has minor issues but what game doesn't you definitely should give it a try for a different take on mobile gaming.

The graphics are great and the battle system is now pretty good. Units are amazing and it is extremely fun. However, I was debating to give it one star because of its rates. It may be fair and it might not be. The devs are trying their best to improve the game and it is very much appreciated. Pvp is still kinda bad because of all the rising rushes being spammed. They have brought about many changes. It is the best gacha game out there. Definitely worth playing.

I like this game a lot, although it has various issues. As of right now, it is easier for free to play players, but it is still heavily pay to will and it will probably always because they need the money, and not to mention when you get further in the game the game becomes more stail. Overall, as a person who has had this game for more than a year now its a soild 3.5 stars, and if your new this game is either a hit or miss for you. You'll either fall in love, or hate the game a lot.

I've played since Beta. Gameplay is good, but sometimes it feels like a turn based game due to limited defensive options (only switching and vanishing). I think you could learn from the ninja storm series, or budokai tenkaichi series when it comes to the "vanishing" mechanics. Also attention to details could improve, not that is bad. Freezer should shoot beams from it's fingers and not energy balls when using blast cards. Character damage and/or stage destruction would be a great implementation.

The developers employ the strategy of forcing the players to spend real money so they can obtain the new characters, which are always the most powerful and dominate the pvp scene (which is what a player will spend most of his/her time on). The game itself is fun, but the fact that a person is heavily rewarded for playing with their credit card puts free to play players at a major disadvantage.

This game is definitely a fun one. Mechanics are significantly better than Dokkan Battle, and is just a cleaner game overall. However, I have two main problems: 1. Please fix the constant loading screens. It is realyly annoying when you are choosing tabs and have to wait 2 seconds before it loads (wow 1st world problems). 2. There is a bug when you occasionally get a black screen when loading into a story mission. Also, pls get me better rng bruh im struggling T-T

I like the game a lot, amazing illustrations, animation, an interesting summon screen & a fun mechanics but the pvp matches barely work. It takes forever to connect if it even does connect and there's no way to back out of the waiting screen except for waiting for that 3 second window where the back arrow comes up or just quitting the game and restarting it.

This game used to be so much fun, but now it's not. The summons are just crazy and the players can be annoying, I know it's a strategy but some people can't do that. And the game feels like a pay to win game now, ever since they released Gohan Beast people had to buy a lot of ccs(Chrono Chrystals) just to get him, and the last two summons weren't easy, I don't get ssj4 Goku and Vegeta until there was 2 days left of the summon. I would give this a 5 star rating but the game isn't as fun anymore.

The game is very entertaining and you can play for hours nonstop, because there is so much stuff to do. Vast selection of characters and definetley reccomend to fans and newcomers to the series alike. The only addition the game would need is a trading system where you can trade your characters with another player. Other than that, the game is pretty much flawless.

Great game but it is semi-turn based, which makes a little bit regretful and increase the complicability for playing (but easier for making). The UI could have become better, the connection time for changing a panel is tooo long, and the system is complicated for a mobile game at first sight (have to take time to learn). I have played for two days, didnt spend money and summoned 7 sps. But after I spent money in it I could hardly summon an sp (10000 diamonds for 3sp). Anyway it's full of child memory and comparing to Honkai 3 it seems less money consuming (however Honkai 3 is probably the best act anime game in mobile currently).

Very fun and good gameplay and very good graphics for a mobile game, I love the gacha element where you do summons to get new characters and I love it because it's mysterious, you never know what you will get, and either way it's always fun. Only reason I don't rate it 5 stars is because it has a lot of updates and I know that only makes sense for such a game that large and interactive, but I wish they would dile it down a bit. Other then that it's a very good game.

An okay game that gets old really quickly. When you reach the higher echelons of the game or PvP, it becomes a very one dimensional game. 1st, it is a gacha game where you hope for a sparkling grade char in your draws. 2nd, at the late game stage, it become the "bait enemy into dodging first so you can dodge their attack then punish them because they cannot dodge anymore" game. Every character fights very similarly in the end. Only variation is the sprite and special move. Gets boring quick.

So far, I've been really enjoying the game. I like the events and the story. Even tho I haven't spent money on this game, I've been getting some good stuff. My problems with the game is some of the grinding with adventures and training. I think obtaining rewards should be a tad bit easier. Or at least give me more slots to use. But moving on to training. My problem with it are the results part. Please add a skipping button. It takes too long to cycle through 20+ characters that I've put in. Thx

Its fun I'll say that but man I wish the fighting was more complicated. You can't decide whether to throw a punch or kick, or even block. You can only dodge attacks. Graphics and visuals are freaking insane though I gotta give em that, it's probably the only reason I still play, however, there's sooooo much downtime spent in-between fights cause of all these tasks you've gotta do 😠OH HUGE THING, PLEASE GIVE A BUTTON TO SUB FIGHTER NEEDED FOR AN EVENT INSTEAD OF HAVING US SEARCH WHOLE ROSTER!!

I love this app.. it's fun and I enjoy the 3d fighting greatly. I really hope though they release more souls for people to have, because I've ran out quite fast and I'm having a tired experience from it.. not only that too but the way they give out crystals sometimes are horrendous. usually its about 100-200 which is fine, but then you have to grind out the rest of the 1000 which takes years to do..

I really do enjoy this game. I've been playing since it first came out. The story is amazing and the work put into characters is astonishing. However, as of recently, the content has dropped. PvP has very uninteresting and tedious, forcing players to adapt to each new style of fighting or creating their own. The limited time events have always been interesting. However, the events that do stay have been there for a long time without change, Ultra Space-time Rush is a good example.

I installed this game just yesterday, so I haven't played much. This is a really fun game. It is F2P friendly. The PvP is great. The pricing is *kinda* decent. I would love the PvP or the story mode to be a little more....strategic? Where you have to plan out your approach before you get into the fight. As many people have stated, the game is actually reallly slow loading. But besides that the game is great. 4 stars

it's okay for what it is, the battle part is just a time waste tho, even if it's the entire gimmick of this game. Wish you could skip it because it really has no impact, it tries too hard to have different game mechanics to make you feel engaged but it doesn't succeed. The rewards in this game are great and I didn't feel like I had to spend money.

I think there's so much potential with this game.. the story lines are great and this could be a ps4 game even with xenoverse 2 graphics. z fighterz was good to I wish there was more free story lines though otherwise great game hopefully shallot can go 1,2,3,4 and or god forms. only real complaint I have would be the shop I wish you earned more medals and I wish there was more you could buy and do to your character unless that part is supposed to be complicated.

This game used to be good, but then it became very pay to win. The only thing about it that is still good is the story and you have to wait for it to update gradually. To get the best cards, you have to spend ridiculous amounts of money and they keep pumping out new ones that are even rarer. Not to mention that you then need duplicates of them for some to be useful. The free cards take forever to grind and getting premium currency takes days of tedious work.

Sparking characters could have an increased chance of dropping, considering it takes 1000 to consecutively summon characters and that takes a long time to earn that many. And decrease the chances of getting the same characters we already have. I understand we can limit break getting the same characters, but it's not even characters I want. The game overall is enjoyable. Just hate the summon system.

I came back after 3 months of not playing. First off, my progress was lost, and I could not recover it. The game has some many bugs I can't even play. If I'm lucky, I get 10 minutes of uninterupted playtime. Really liked the game before, that's why I came back, but with the game crashing so much, it's not enjoyable. Will change my score if the crashing gets fixed.

This is a great Dragon Ball game if you're looking for something new. It has a level up system and you can collect rare characters and train through the story mode or rank up in multiplayer. The way you summon characters can be frustrating when you don't receive what you want but about every character can be good with skill.

Good game, but it's your average gacha at this point, and the pity system is all but unforgiving unless you are willing to put in money for the character you want at the time. And the scaling for those characters are broken for those who put in tons of money to summon and max out the characters, which doesn't work well with the rank-based PvP. Still a fun game, but Toshi needs to stop being money-hungry.

Update:That attack glitch where you can't even get a chance to fight back needs taking down. First of all it makes no sense. You can fly over,hit a little sidestep and recharge and still attack again. But if you simply hit a card,charge a little bit,and if you attack after this they dodge. This mechanics is dumb. If you run into these players you might as well put your phone or controller down. You won't get a fair fight. Now it's a challenge up and the AI is fighting this way,it's ridiculous!

The gameplay is great, controls are too. It looks phenomenal, but the rates..the rates. I'm sure in the future there will be guaranteed sparkings once the game pushes out more units but it is annoying to spend money on the game and or take your time to grind out crystals just to get a multi full of heroes and maybe one extreme. And how one sided pvp is for P2P v. F2P. Other than that I thoroughly enjoy the game and the story! I'm sure you guys will fix such issues in the future.

One of the best dragon ball games right here folks. Offers tons of characters to play as, a gacha, a story mode, f2p methods of getting stuff, p2w ways of getting stuff, let's you see the db world from a new perspective. Alas though the game gets boring sometimes and you may have to take a break from it, and also lately the app keeps not responding making it so others and I cannot play it.

Having been a day one player, it's been a ride of ups and downs like any adventure in life. Lately, it's just been downhill into a ravine. There's no care or joy in the game or from the developers. It's more of a cash grab and designed for whales to have fun while everyone else is pushed out. It's grindy and tedious and I've had to stop playing it cause it was no longer fun and took way too much time out of my day. I love Dragonball as a series and wanna show my support but not with this game.

It's addictive, and I'm enjoying the game so far. It takes forever to connect multiplayer matches though, so I end up not playing many. I'd like to see the matchmaking get better, but otherwise it's pretty solid. **update, pvp needs work, it seems connections aren't always stable. One game will go fine, then the next I'm matched with someone that is lagging so bad the game freezes for seconds at a time, and I cant even hit the opponent with a good shot. It just goes right through them.*

Pretty good game over all. My main issues are 1. The story is actually pretty good, but they never actually tell us when we get more story and the "previews" at the end of the part you beat until the next update gives no preview or insight into when there will be an update for more story. I think they need to release it faster. 2. The PvP needs work. Laggy and glitchy. 3. As most others have said, takes a bit too long grind and get the souls to summon. And the sparking rates are too low. Up em'

This is honestly not a mobile game. It should be on the level of real games. Now, playing the game itself can be boring, like the fighting parts. But doing the quests, getting characters, and upgrading them, it's all so fun. My only big problem is the chrono crystals. It can take a while to just get 1000, the average to get lots of good characters. This is pretty annoying because I don't want to buy them. But you kinda need to get a lot. It can be very annoying. Also...NO ADS!!!

Absolutely Terrible. The most common way to obtain characters is to summon for them, spending tickets or CC, (Chrono crystals, the games main currency) but the rates are absolutely TERRIBLE. The lastest characters to have been released are "Ssj3 Goku & Ss2 Vegeta" but the rates are so low, it's almost as bad as trying to pull an Ultra. The units are extremely broken and unbalanced, and absolute hell just to get a single copy of. I do not recommend this game, as it has so much "Pay to Win" in it.

Playing the game for the 4th year and still love it. Although you may not always get the shiny new characters but that's all based on RNG. The graphics and animations are amazing and cool. Great to play during my free time. Although I don't play much pvp, but if you're into challenging battles, you ought to give it a try.

I originally gave this game 5 stars when it first came out, but it's changed so much since then, and not for the better. Its utterly pay to win, and lately, highly desirable character summons are often locked behind paywalls with no means to get the items necessary to summon them just by playing the game. Devs have gotten greedy, so after over a year of playing several hours a day, every day, I've uninstalled.

Great game. Garbage online stability. You'll hit a button, but the game doesn't register it until 3sec later where you're suddenly being beat up on. For a game where timing is key, the fact that it is so horrid online is kinda damning. I've had opponents disconnect while prepping for a match multiple times. This last time, it docked me 25pvp pts and prevented me from playing pvp for a time. I'm not the one that disconnected/lost connection. Fix your game connectivity.

I love playing this game, and there are so many characters that are available for you to get. The way of getting characters is very RNG-Based though, so be aware of that when getting the characters. Other than that, I recommend this game to people 13 and above, especially if they're a Dragon Ball, Dragon Ball Z, or Dragon Ball Super fan. After a few years of playing this game, it has got much worse, and there's close to no Chrono Crystals available once you grind them all.

I loved this game. I've been playing it for the past 5 years, Often running in to hackers, Server lag, Terrible team building mechanics, Pay to win If you don't have the media units, don't go online & won't let you update occasionally. Some of the many problems. All around was one of my favorite games. Options to fix some of the most common problems. • Shouldn't have the strongest units work on any tag. • Bring all sparking units to around the same level, same with LL and ultra's

I have been playing the new battle royal game mode and, to be honest I have only been winning but, for some bizarre reason the debs of this game though to add a feature that allows you to disconnect from and online limited edition of PvP battles and not be penalised expect for a warning that is often not upheld. I have currently won 5 battles but I have only been rewarded for 2 of them because of this disconnect exploit that has been around since the last event. I love this game but I'm fed up

Honestly, the game is repetitive but its characters help the game. Some characters have unique skills, finishes, and play styles. The multiplayer is good, I never had a time that made me hate the game. Grinding for items is tedious (What do I expect for a mobile RPG) Also, Shallot and Giblet are the only Saiyans that use Super Saiyan God with a tail, and I think that's pretty cool.

Pretty decent game. Graphics are nice, gameplay is alright too. Fun to get new characters and level up system isnt too bad either. I grew up with Dragonball so it's nice to see something like this. Things that can be better: UI performance is slow. Improvements in this area would be better to the quality of the game. Navigation is also mediocre at best. Too many clicks between UI screens to get to desired areas. Other game modes such as alliances/groups for more interactive play.hope to see improvements coming up.

This games combat is very fun, though the meta of the game revolves around having the newest units, therefor players who don't like grinding a lot or just don't expect to hop on the game a lot will suffer due to newer units out competing the ones you just got. Plus if you just get unlucky and don't pull any good new units, your team is as good as done for in the long run, as most f2p characters get out performed very quickly.

I have been enjoying the story mode of the game, although there are pointless battles there sometimes, that have just been implemented to make things take longer. I like how good units keep returning, it's quite entertaining. The thing that I like least is how limited it is to obtain Chrono crystals, there are not many ways, they are very time consuming and the amount you get is too little.

So I am a dedicated dragon Ball z fan and I've been watching the show ever since the original dragon Ball came out. I just got to say that I absolutely love the graphics in this game and the combat system is really simple to learn yet worth it to master. The addition of constantly new characters and different events keeps this game fresh and fun. I've been playing it for years and it still hasn't lost its touch. Keep up the good work you guys it's awesome.

As a Dragonball fan since I was a kid, DBZ is when I started. This game really brings you into the Dragonball universe. Especially with it's own unique story. (Wish they'd make an actual show). The gameplay is easy and fun. Leveling and boosting your characters is a fun aspect. I have over 150 characters already, almost all at max level. AND no in game ads! Love it. If you're a DBZ fan, it's a must have game, especially for free. Love this game.

Love this game! The only issue I have is with the challenges, alot of unnecessary back and forth like for instance. fight with 1 or less character then its says land an attack with 2 or more red characters. if my hand does not consist of a red character I'd have to go back and re-do my whole line up. can we stick to on color or topic at a time feels like it would be alot smoother.

Good game but repetitive stuff to do, just slide/tap again and again, not to forget it's almost pay to win. To win in PvP you need the best characters and for that you need to use chrono crystals, once you have finished story there isn't much of a way to get chrono crystals. Other than that, it's well good enough for a mobile game, though making it a non p2w or at least rewarding 100 chrono crystal instead of 10 it would be far better

Great game, the art is 10/10 especially great when you summon a sparking, the art really brings home the excitement of getting a rare summon. Something id like them to help with is the downloads, the game is quite big and you have to reserve a lot of space for it, if its possible i think all of us fans would like to see a sort of storage server for the game allowing us to play without downloading as much, beside that setback the game is pretty much perfect, the story is engaging and it runs well

The game was going so great, i randomly stopped playing for a week and all of the sudden the game wouldn't work at all. I had to uninstall and reinstall and it still barely works for 5 minutes. I know im not on wifi when i play but i have great service and didnt have any issues before. There are some serious bugs that might need fixing.

It's definitely a fun and can be intense during pvp fights. I do want there to be more characters that we don't really see like Hatchiyak (may have misspelled), Dr Wheelo, etc. There's a lot of the same characters, whether better versions like the Ultra Characters, or worse like Hero rarity. Definitely would like to see more character variety

Straight a bad game for free to play. old units never get reworked anymore and they are unusable. Zenkai awakening is not free to play friendly and the strongest units are locked behind zenkai's. Without spending a SIGNIFICANT ( more than i ever seen before in a game) amount of money you will never be able to keep up with the game. edit: the devs put a lot of effort to make this game look gorgeous and put many easter eggs for the fans of the series

The tutorial was a little annoying, but aren't they all? In any case, the game looks really good, and has really cool music. I despise the leveling system though, I would have to be dedicated night and day to this app to be in any way competent and caught-up with all the different leveling things you have to do. Dokkan Battle did leveling so much better it's not even funny.

Great game, casual time killer, fun fighting mechanics. Cool if you also like crate opening (you do have to save up in game though.) I do wish there were better in game tutorials for combos, though. Some people in pvp land crazy combos, but I guess that's what happens when you get into the higher ranks. Great game if you like strategic team building, too.

Best game for me by far. Been playing for about 5 years now, and still it takes the top spot. Shallot story line, animation & everything else... Insanely good. But I do agree with Aziza Fakir... That could be awesome. Also the collection of Dragon balls. I hardly know people that actually play the game. So scanning the code doesn't really help me, not sure if I'm the only one. But if it where extremely challenging missions/task battles in order to obtain them. I think that could be good move.

I mean it's a good game, don't get me wrong. And I like how your able to get legends limited characters for the first week. but after 2 weeks of me playing this, it seems to get a little too repetitive when it came to it sure we have events and co ops and stuff, but the biggest parts of this game is story, summon, pvp. The same old thing over and over. And free to play players suffer the most. Because their is no pity on the summons, and the good characters get harder and harder to get

Love the game, love the story, love the direction BUT!! I'm rating so low for one BIG reason. The chrono crystal system is broken! Once you've exhausted or played all the events/and gotten all stars for story mode, there's no way to obtain chrono crystals without buying them. Figure out a way to add in a progressive game mode that grants you more CC for clearing harder and harder quests that don't ever stop. I couldn't summon on this past weekend 50% SP rate because I've exhausted available CC

If you like DBZ then you'll love this. But brand recognition aside, it is a pretty lousy game. It's less of a game and more of a mechanic tickets to buy stuff. There's so many tutorials right out of the gate. There's barely any chance for you to kind of discover what's going on because all of it's forcefed to you. If you can sit through all that you'll probably enough this.

I'd give this game a higher rating if you guys made it easier to get Chrono Crystals. I mean easier as in at the end of every week we should get 1000 or at least 700 CC, cause there aren't enough missions in this game to casually grind up to, oh let's say 10,000 CC. We're not Rhyme, Nano, or Kaggy. Most of us just can't spend money like they can.

I love this game alot and have been playing it since it's release but I do have some minor complaints . The drop rate for rare characters is extremely low I can go through 12-15 summons without getting something decent . The game can really feel pay to win and the chrono crystals prices are absolutely absurd . Also the matchmaking in pvp is a little unfair at times , Still a solid game all around though . Very addicting

Great art, animations, character roster, and voice over work. Unfortunately it struggles in the one area that matters most when playing a dbz game and that's the combat. Controls could stand to be considerably tighter for a game so fast paced. Opponents tend to get very spammy at higher levels which does not reflect skill or difficulty but cheapness. Make the controls more responsive and i will definitely give this 5 stars.

I've been playing this game for a pretty long time and more improvements keep coming especially with the characters. if you're looking for a dragon ball game that could keep you company I recommend this game because it has a lot of Futures that you have to do to master your characters it's challenging and that's what makes it fun!

Significantly better than when first released. However, currently having problems where specific characters can't be soul boosted. For example, if I try to SB my SP Broly for time sensitive missions it freezes the game right out. It brings me into the sb screen but with only a back button, no other details, and the back button is useless. Fix please

I will first say that I am indeed a Dragon Ball fan from way back, and I am blown away by this game.. It looks bloody amazing and has some really great animations and so on, which shows so beautifully in the fights. There are a ton of ways to power up your characters, and my god, there's so many characters from across the entire series that it is almost endless with the glorious growth or team builds. The draw system is A+ too with very reasonable and consistent drop rates. Amazing game.

It's a great game. And it gives you the chance to enjoy it without spending any money. But the grinding you need to do in order to do as I said sometimes can be quite tiring. Oh well, there are some people you have all the op characters etc and that's really kinda. Oooof p2w? Whatsoever, as for the mechanics it's a nice game smooth. But I have noticed some random crashes lately: 1. Stack on loading screen forever. 2. Game crashing while on main screen. They are not consistent. Here and there.

After the various new updates and adjustments made, the game has made a great comeback. Aside from the boring and time consuming events, the PVP has improved quite a bit as now it has better matchmaking and you can use characters that were previously average with the new Tier system. The only major issues I have is, again, the boring single player events and the lack of content at times. If you're a big fan of Dragon Ball then this game is definitely for you.

My experience was terrible. I had it for a few months before deleting it. I had a few problems with the game. 1. The drop rates were super low. It was hard to get good characters and you constantly got the same characters 2. I was at a point were I had grinded for some good characters, but then for some reason, my game restarted and I lost everything. I had to start over from the beginning (and I just got a 5 Star Gogeta), so I got really mad and deleted the game. Please fix this.

so the developers have been very good in fixing a lot of the problems the game had when it came out but for the love of God can you please up the equipment cap? you can only have 250 pieces of equipment and when it fills up because it will if you play the game on a regular basis you can't do missions and it gets very annoying having to throw away valuable pieces of equipment

Really good game actually, my only complaints are the in game currency to summon is over priced to buy with money. And the game can be a bit laggy at times when your doing pvp, but not the LOL extent lag Haha. My only other one I guess would be is that I would like the stamina bar to fill quicker so I dont have to constantly waste gems filling it. Great game though, I do recommend at least trying it!!

I love this game!! It's sooo adicting I don't think i'm gonna stop playing it any time soon. I love all of the updates that they add. Although they take a while to donwload, if you have the storage, it's definitely worth it. For a free mobile game, it has incredible quality and gameplay. Also the everyday missions make the game alot more entertaining. 5-stars forever!!!

As a person who isn't really well versed in the dragon ball franchise, I thought the game was pretty cool. The graphics and storyline are amazing. The main character gets really strong as you progress, so he's worth investing in. The drop rates are fair. I got all the characters I wanted without paying a dime. There's alot variety in who you can play as since there's rarely forced requirements. The game isn't pay to win, just be consistent.

This game is by far one of the best mobile games I have played in ages, from the character art and models, new events often, amazing gameplay, great pvp, and my favorite part are the summons. The one thing that I'm not too fond of is the lag during pvp and the crashing, other than that it's an amazing and addictive game, it's not pay to win either due to the amount of ways you can earn chrono crystals. 8/10

(Launch) Entertaining Dragon Ball Game. It's like Brave Frontier but for DB. I just feel like it needs more characters. But I'm guessing it's because it's recently new. Awesome game still just more characters (Edit:4/24/19) I'm Lv 130+ at this point. It's an addicting game but now is more about balancing the game & Inventory space. Like how the old season characters gotta be almost in par with the new ones and how they have to increase the inventory about 250. Just to break the iceberg.

First time I tried getting this game it didn't work, this time however it did and I'm so glad of that. This game is extremely addictive and fun to play.
