Bit annoyed the harder level bosses can't be beaten without a certain character that you can only get if you complete that levels challenge, otherwise its a great game. Wish we could delete unwanted characters or at least have the option to activate them or not, so many low level unwanted characters.

Very fun and addictive , but more importantly can be played fairly competitively free to play. Edit : still fun , but no where near free to play anymore . Between the star system changes the zenkai system ( which is just bad on every level as it is atm) and the legends limit rates . It makes it alot hard to use free to play teams or just try new units on fun teams. Not saying you cant skill still matters, just much more difficult.

This game is really fun, but summoning in this game is kinda problematic that's why I've been waiting for an update that would let us TRADE characters that we need desperately. Guild and friend trades would bring this game to another level and maybe bring people back who stopped because a summon didn't give them the character they want. That space in the menu top right corner is gonna stay blank forever if they don't do something with it.

great mobile game. but the card fighting system can become one sided if you abuse certain tactics, leaving you helpless against those who do so and the vanish step never seems to work most of the time. The pull rate for characters is total trash. I've spent a good bit of $ in the past, only to get garbage. Would NOT recommend putting your money into this game. Just grind for a bit to get your crystals.

The graphics are crazy good!!! Gameplay is like that in a console or pc. And the micro transactions are probably unessential... Overall I love the game! And yes the story mode gets kinda boring when one has to read every conversation... It would be better if that thing could be simplified with recorded conversations...

This game is absolutely amazing and gorgeous graphics at high resolution. The gameplay is fluid and each attack flows fluently into another and control are matched by timing. There no button mashing I really like that and I'm thoroughly enjoying myself as a true dragon ball z fan. Thanks for this awesome game. I don't know but after the update I can't play any missions when the energy falls under 3 and it will automatically kick me back to the title screen. I don't know why it keeps happening to me?

One of the better DragonBall games on mobile I've played. One could compare it to the console line of DragonBall games. But, getting better characters in summon per single ticket should be at a way higher percentage. Also, the crystals should be at least half the price they are currently in the store. I've calculated it should bring in more purchases in the long run.

The game is becoming better and better by each update and is a blast to play. My only complains are, that they should release more legends Road characters (more events in general actually), and less daily login challenges, that you can only play once per day. Also, this is far fetched but I wish there was a trading system in which you could trade characters z powers! It would make zenkaing units, and upgrading teams, way easier! It would also give a use for the units that you don't need.

I absolutely love it. This game is awesome and I would recommend it to a dragon ball fan straight away. I love the amount of different characters in it and how you can have all your favourite movie and TV fighters in a powerful team to take on the world in PvP. And you can't describe the feeling of getting a good summon that you've been waiting for for ages!

I typically dislike mobile games, because as a PC gamer, I have very high expectations for a game, especially dbz. This game has exceeded my expectations with flying colors. The new storycontent picks up just at the conclusion of DragonBall Super, however there are no spoilers, which I seriously appreciate. Every time I see an update I get so psyched to play more of the new story line! I wish I could personally thank Akira Toriyama for continuing to impress me, as he has for the last 30 years.

It's just fine. After you complete the story mode it's really hard to consistently earn crystals outside of some events, and the pvp system is really counterintuitive because the game teaches you to play WORSE than other players, but other than that there isn't much to complain about as long as you're okay with grinding. Update: since this review they've added a new "training" quest line which teaches you a lot more about the PVP system.

The game looks good and also the visuals and more recent models. Although the game has become a lot more laggy every sense the major update we got months ago and it would sometimes result in inputs not registering mid game. Other than that, the game is pretty solid. (Except their absurd prices for shi in the shop... some of these P2W people must be spending HUNDREDS on this game for one unit they may not get...💀)

Great game but cross platform transfers from apple to android wouldn't work, the game crashes when you switch from wifi to data and takes a day to be operational again. If you leave the app and come back to it theres a high possibility of it crashing but the game is so addicting and the quality is exceptional I have a hard time putting it down. Just really frustrating at times....

The game is exceptional in terms of graphics and the combat system, but I believe the devs should consider implementing more options for players to earn gems, as veteran players such as myself find it difficult to earn gems as we have completed most of the missions and events. The game has succeeded as a f2p game, so I hope the devs consider keeping it that way.

It's a great game. Very entertaining. The new ul unit has the greatest animations I've seen in game and out. My only problem is every once in a while the game refuses to work. Like right now every time I try to log in it simply won't connect. The screen won't even pop up. Just says there is a problem.usually resetting my phone makes it work but it's not working at all right now.

Love the game, probably the best content of any mobile game. It's extensive and tons of characters to collect and no ads. It's almost too good to be true, it's even better than some games I've played on the console. Only problem I'm having currently is; I'm on Part 7. Book 5. Chapter 7. and for some reason the game freezes every single time I beat Android 13. Like nothing happens, everything just stops. If I can get an update as to why that is that would be great.

im rating the anniversary. so it had lots of great content and new things introduced. So if I can stay calm and overlook the times when my game would be moving at Mach -1 speeds, was laggy as hell and burning up my phone, things weren't so bad. got real good when part 2 rolled around and the 3rd has been awesome as well. there are a couple of things that aren't perfect but ive already put that into the survey. the anni been awesome for sure. but for a while my game exp was laggy and hot.

It's a very good game, the story missions are amazing, the graphics are betted than most console games, and the characters are beautiful. The only thing is, the summon rates are garbage. I summoned three times on each new banner, and the Goku Blue one literally gave me nothing but heroes and extremes, while the vegeta one gave me the new super vegito and a bunch of other sparkings. I think that, while i am extremely happy about what i got, i just wish that the new units had a higher summon rate.

The game has stunning graphics, authentic voice acting, and epic special moves. However, the game also has some flaws that can be frustrating. The game also requires a lot of grinding and patience to unlock new characters and items, which can be annoying if you don’t want to spend money. The game can also be buggy and laggy, especially in PvP mode. The game is fun and immersive, but it is not perfect.

Well, mostly good, when it works. Game is fun and expanding (uses quite a bit of he space) pvp can sometimes take 15+ minutes only to freeze and not connect, app has to reload only to find out I lost? Maintenance takes a very looooong time, like almost a whole day on more than 1 occasion. I like the game, but what's the point when maintenance seems static at times. Please fix, or don't (and I will delete and move on)

Love the game, but please make the games combat more engaging. The frustration of not being able to counter simple things or my character gets trapped in something easy to get out of bothers me. This game will be great and more addictive if more combat was issued. The only thing that drives me away at times. I know yall won't, but please. Maybe in a future major update. Either way, it's the best anime phone game. In my opinion, just please reconcile the combat system.

You're not guaranteed to get sparkings in all the summons. The only way to get crystals is to buy or play for hours only to do a single multi. The online is terrible due to major lag and disconnects for every match. Zenkai is a horrible mechanic considering the fact that to fully awaken them you have to waste some money for a SINGLE character. Devs, this is the time to fix your game because it has to many problems to deal with. Don't waste your time on this game. If you do, don't buy anything.

Best game ever i recommend give it a shot you will not regret it . ;) . (Updated): i am bored of this game new units seem boring and it's getting repitative developers are just adding extra character into game no new features or modes and they reduce the crystals you can gain by quest . The only reason I gave it 2 star is because I had fun playing the game for 1 year I was happy after that it got boring. Update: i no longer play game it's repetitive.

I'm an anime fan, but not so much Dragonball Z. However, a friend was doing an event & needed to scan friends codes to collect 7 Dragonballs. He convinced me to play & I've been home ever since. I hate it having to load after every single action though. Extremely tedious & time consuming.. considering i get so addicted at times, I find little minutes throughout the day to play, but it takes forever to load the game even with the best data & WiFi combined.. so I wind up unable to play mostly.

It's gorgeous to look at and the controls are really novel and fun. I'm all for supporting Devs and I've spent money on this game. Unfortunately, the gacha model seems to be the most profitable. It's essentially gambling, but instead of money you're chasing bits and bytes. I'm fond of Dragonball, but without that, I'd steer clear.

This is the best DBZ game on the mobile in my opinion. It's fairly new but has loads of content. The PVP is very fun and competitive, with rankings and seasons. It has a story mode also, and an "ok" at best customizable character. But in all honesty, to sum this game up fully, imagine if Xenoverse and Dokkan Battle had a child, this is it. perfect for the mobile and comfortable to play on mobile. Also weekly login gifts are fairly generous, you can build an amazing team very quickly.

Really like the game but yhe biggest problem is the crappy dodge mechanic its so hit or miss, i actually would be ready and still miss or my character would attack instead which is such a let down the motion should be so crisp but instead it leaves much to be desired making you miss most of yout perfect wins in pvp and in story mode... i will rate it higher once i see a update... but for now i'm loosing my interest. Combat is only as fun when the controls are as tight and precise.

This is really solid, I don't have a console and I just got a non-iPhone for the first time and it can actually run games! I tried DBZ dokkan battle before this and it wasn't what I wanted, it was nothing like the 3D combat games I love DBZ for, this is. The controls are maybe too simple and theres way too many push notifications in the app but you actually fight and level up characters in what I imagine is the closest you can get to the original budikai series on a mobile phone!

it's a decent game, but like, the story isn't finished so most of us are already done with everything with little room to improve our characters. Secondly, getting the characters you want is almost nonexistent. Getting any sort of sparking character is a slim to none chance. I play the game, but not as much as I would with the listed improvements.

The game is fun, I enjoy it. Farming for gems is easy and nothing difficult at first, but Major Concerns about the PvP I do enjoy it but sometimes it's impossible to play. When I first enter a match it starts off fine but then it feels unplayable when the enemy team has an infinite combo, Several Matches end with my team getting knocked out almost immediately because I couldn't get out of the way of an attack. I wish there was some kind of block feature.

its a great game. personally i think the time it takes to do adventures and traning is very long. Also i think a more reliable crystal farm would be nice, dont get me wrong theres alot of ways to get crystals but when certain mission spike in difficulty or require a specific thing it throw you off of the grind. the energy system isnt bad at all but it does get frustrating but that just the nature of that kind of macanic.

A lot of you are complaining about the money purchases and the rng. Sparking is not meant to be easy to get. Come on. Second, I have paid $0 and have almost every character in the game. And I'm not really trying. If you're a free player. Do your event missions and you'll be fine. They give away chrono crystals like mad if you're playing the events right. This game is fantastic. Never had your can't load unless it was genuine maintenance, get a better phone.

I have been waiting for a nice Dragon Ball game like this for years and now I have finally found what I am looking for. The fighting is fun, pvp is great, soul boost mechanics are amazing, and all in all just a great game. I do have 2 harps: the story does take awhile to get into. I have found myself not going through for days on end, but it is still fun. Also, sometimes more often than not, in pvp I often get matched with players MUCH stronger than me. I hope this can get fixed in the near futur

The best Dragonball mobile game in my opinion. Incredible gameplay, graphics, events and much more. The only reason why I wouldn't rate this a 5 star game is because of the unfair disadvantage of free to play players when it comes to summoning for new characters and then when it comes to unfair match ups in PvP. All in all, it is a good game.

I love the game so much been playing for almost 4 years now, and I never had a issue until now. Recently I have been getting a bug with the legends pass where I would have it for 2-3 day and it would expire when it should last a month. This issue has happened twice now and It would be helpful if the team would look into that bug, because if I'm putting money into the game I want what I buy to last its said amount of time.

As a Dragon Ball Z fan, I simply adore this game. It has so many characters to unlock, contains a big story mode for those who DON'T like short story modes. The combat style ressembles like of Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 ( kind of). In other words, the gameplay is amazing ! Although this game does possess a energy meter, you don't have to pay real money to recharge your energy. There are many ways to recharge your energy. This game is worth of 5 stars.

This game is very fun to play on the side whenever I'm looking to be entertained when waiting, and even then it has some pretty fun and exciting content to look forward to from time to time. The only gripes I have is the amount Chrono Crystal's you get without paying (Ex. When doing the story mode challenges) and some units are a bit stressful to get especially when they may not last forever (thus leaving them unobtainable)! Otherwise, fun game, love the story so far and I'm enjoying Shallot.

When I first started, I loved it because it had a light console vibe. The game has a ton of repetition. The popups downright exhausted me each time I had to open the game. Not ads, but just event popups when they could easily just make it a single page. Lastly the summon rates aren't the best. They give a ton of free rolls at least, but aiming for a single character is abysmal. It's decent, but nothing long term for me.

My only real complaint is the training with trunks is too unfriendly and then that the how to get certain items and what they are used for can get lost in all the information. Other than that it's a fun time I don't fully know what I'm doing but I have a bunch of UR characters and they do really cool stuff and I like it the team behind this game takes creative liberties but they are all great choices imo if your a dragon ball fun you will like it if your not it might convince you to give it try

Very fun "fighting" game. I use fighting loosely here I just don't really know how else to classify it. It's a team based Brawler(?) where you have one character out on the field at a time. Really epic gameplay and animations. Top notch mobile graphics and gameplay. If you are at all a Dragon Ball fan this is a must play. Also as of this review the 2 year anniversary is underway and you get a TON of free stuff. It's insane. Give it a try! You won't regret it.

This game is great. In almost every way. I really love how it brings bavk the old anime in Event mode. And how you have the options to train/limit break your characters. Just like how they were always getting stronger in the series. My only complaknt is that energy takes way too long to revover just 1 bar. 20 mins is ridiculous. I think 5 or 10 mins would be bearable. The other is that fights are extremely one sided. You either win effortlessly or get wiped out post haste. One of DB's main plot points was that strength is not everything and that hard work overcomes prowess. Also I think its hillarious how when you use Killin's destructo disc. It always says "miss" even if it hits. Calling back to the fact he never actually hits anyone with it in all of DB history to my recollection at least.

It's a really good game and it would of gotten 5 stars and it could, but the loading and connection is so low and I have to always hit the retry button over and over every 10mins and I have good wifi. Which ends up getting annoying and frustrating, so if y'all can find a way to make it run smoother than I would appreciate it. But overall the game is really fun and amazing there is so much that you can do! Its amazing how the game has developed and I hope to see it improve.

love it most addicting game I've ever played. Easy to learn but hard to master. With great looks and new content regularly. This is definitely a top tier mobile game. Edit: It's fixed! I've been playing again for a few days and my problem of constant connection errors doesn't happen anymore. I didn't get a new device, and no our internet and data plan didn't change. So whatever the dev team did worked like a charm.

Probably one of the best Mobile DBZ games I ever played it's very addictive and challenging as a fighting game should be. It can be costly if you want to grab some unique characters along the way the package deals can be quite enticing. Lol. It's been a pleasureable experience and I've been a player since the apps release date.

This game could be fantastic in my opinion. I had fun playing it but now, I don't know if I should still be having that. The graphics are gorgeous for a mobile game and the characters are phenomenal. But, this game becomes more and more into pay to win or pay to play. The PvP is awful like you either fight someone that's stronger than you or vice versa. The summon rate is also a shame. It's very hard for me as a dragon ball fan to uninstall this but now I have finally done it. Could be better!

It's obvious that the devs are using the Dragon Ball name to scam people. The crystals are ridiculously overpriced, especially considering how poor the pull rates are for the good characters. It's pay to win, and somehow even that isn't enough. Unless you're spending exorbitant amounts of money, you're basically left with nothing to do as there's no real content and multiplayer is ruled by the newest characters so the developers can continue to milk the player base. It's really pathetic actually.

It is a very good game overall, but one thing that could change is the equipment system. It is very difficult to get an s rank equipment piece, and now z+ is added. Great. Also, in rating matches, people like me are often placed against pay to win players when we reach higher ranks, which leaves us at a major disadvantage. I just believe that this game should be more friendly towards the majority of people, who do not pay to win. Many people love dragon ball, but not everyone can spend.

I've had this game for some months now and I've never stopped playing it. This type of game will lasts a lifetime. Great game quality and very action packed. I just wish i could soul boost higher than Super. It would be cool if you could transform Shallot to Super Saiyan 2 and also actually unlock some accessories instead of having it be blank. STILL A GREAT GAME THO!!

Current adventure missions are way too time consuming for even the most dedicated of players let alone the average playerbase. These missions are some of the only incentives for free-to-play player and I can not in good conscience recommend the game to that audience at this time until this issue is fixed. Other gameplay aspects like pvp combat and story are solid and are worth the time investment if you can manage to put together a good team.

It used to be a great game, very challenging at times. PVP is decent, unless you are a sweaty player, you won't have much luck if fighting against the veterans. Very good gameplay, easy to learn, hard to master. Interesting story with all the all-time characters but expect people to play the meta. With so much characters in this game, most units are useless unless they are part of an event where you are required to use them. Overall, enjoyable experience.

Amazing game! please, bring to us the option to link an equipament to a character, that would help a lot to often change teams, because always that we have to change any character in a team we gotta always equip the equipes on them again, with time it make players avoid to change a character of the team and trying new combinations, please give to us this option! i'd love to see Android 21 in the game as well! :)

I love this game best anime game I've ever played (on mobile). This game could be better and I have a few suggestions. One is an offline mode where you can do side characters stories like Zahha. More types of characters. For example the black masked saiyan the devastator. Or Demigra. People sleep on these characters and they deserve more respect. Just a thought. Also less bots in PVP the rank is not as good as it should be. I haven't lost a game since 20 rounds. I beat one with 1 character

No real issues with this app. I can definitely see people claiming this is "pay to win", but you can absolutely compete in the PVP side of things with free to play characters, and the gems and pulls you get for good characters regularly come so you eventually will get the "op" characters. I have spent some money on this game, but very quickly went back to some of the free to play characters and teams I built. Plenty of guides online to understand the fighting "mechanics".

The game it's self is amazing, from the characters to the story, it's all great! Then we get to the bad, it crashes a lot sometimes for no reason, the battle screen has a tendency to go completely dark, UI included, and many more bugs! Please fix the game Bandi! edit: forgot to mention the game glitches and switches the languange settings to Japanese for no reason (on a English setting file)

An addictive and fun dragon Ball universe game that utilizes the tactical strategy of the player. I think it's a really fun mobile game, its not hard to learn yet there is alot of strategy in your fights as well, it can be for casual play or for being the best but which ever way you play it you are bound to have fun, ontop of that updates are frequent which means theres always more to do, in my opinion this game is one of the best games on mobile and if you havent tried it then you should. whaddya say? lets give it a shot

I would give it 5 stars, but the amount of hoops necessary to jump through to get some of your favorite characters is ridiculous. Not even the most powerful ones. As a girl, I love when the rare opportunity strikes to acquire a female fighter, but it's almost impossible to get them without micro transactions. Make it easier for casual collectors and less about maxing characters for pvp content.

The graphics, gameplay, and storyline are all good but once you beat the story it becomes extremely difficult to obtain chrono crystals for the summons. I understand they cant update the game as quick as we want them to but should make an easier way to get crystals by either gaining a large amount of crystals for completing all challenges in a chapter, or add another bonus battle that appears daily and gives a certain amount of chrono crystals(roughly somewhere around 20-40) and raise lvl cap.

I love this game ine of the best games i ever player. I unfortuneatly got hit with a ban but this game still remains one of the best games by far. The graphics and mechanics are outstanding, but there are some major drawbacks. The summon rates are nothing short of awful, especially considering how long it takes to grind out enough chrono crystals to be able to summon for whatever character you want. Of course they can be purchased, which makes sense, but what they charge is absolutely insane. Characters, graphics, story, all great, but I think it has fallen off, for there are too many characters with overpowered abilities and mechanics that it gets frustrating very quickly. It is also so luck dependant on not only the summoning but the gameplay as well. There aren't many event options to choose from, meaning you can't farm chrono crystals forcing you to spend money on the game, just to not get the unit you summoned for time and time again. The game is not like it used to be.

I love this game along with everything DB except dokkan and I'd love to give a full five stars but along with many bugs I've noticed one Thats particularly annoying, is one I feel isn't a bug at all. Very surprised at how well a Mobile game has kept my attention. Its advertised as a fast pace, action, CARD GAME, but DOES NOT FEEL LIKE JUST THAT AT ALL. In a way it feels like Im playing Xenoverse but on my phone. Very easy to grind for the resources you need to improve characters you own instead of feeling the pressure of having to buy the micro-transactions in game. I often forget that they are there. Very Well Done!!!!

Game is extremely fun. The only downside, you guessed it, pull rates. Complete trash. I spent $40 and grinded for days to accumulate 8,000 (possibly more) chrono crystals, and did not pull jack. If you're looking for fun this game will do, but don't expect to get the characters you want. Lesson learned.

If there's one thing that should be FIX immediately is PLAYER VS PLAYER! I can't stress you how overly dull and stupid this is due to someone's internet, Either this is intentional or not, it is barely playable if I am facing someone outside of my country. I can't move my character, I have to predict hard, I can't sidestep at times where I could have do it, It is so laggy that it gave the enemy more time than he should to sidestep. Its a great expirience to follow a story of Dragon Ball, but it doesn't have that "i can do whatever trick i want" or any customization to make your characters to truly feel special. Maybe if the Ki Blast, were a different kind of "technique" or at least a little style in how the gameplay is and maybe customization for individual characters. Amazing game I'm sure at some point I will hit a wall like all of these games but it been out long enough that feels far off, they give you everything you can buy in large quantities so I have never felt like I was pushed to buy anything. The game itself is wonderful the fighting feels fluid it's simple enough you can jump right in but gets deep enough if you allow it that it will require thought. I'd say that this game is pretty good overall, it provides some challenges, and is great for collecting new characters and learning about them. Although there is two things in this game that I would like to see fixed, one of which is lowering the price of chrono crystals required for summoning, and second I wish summons gave players rarer characters a bit more often. Well let's say it's fun when you adventure getting to know each characters gimmicks and such. Fun DragonBall game, you build the iconic characters from the series. It's a swipe and tap fighting game with cards for attacks. Easy to do with a few advanced moves. For the most part the best team wins, though with skill you can cheese a win against a better team. It looks great and the sound is good also. You can get things quicker by paying, but I've played a couple months without spending anything and have enjoyed playing the game with my son. There is a coop and pvp.

The best dbz experience on mobile. Wish crystals were a little bit easier to come by or things didn't cost as much but I haven't had to spend any money on this game to get some of the top characters in the game. Very obtainable. Best game for the Dragon Ball fans. Awesome graphics! Only little thing is that sometimes while trying to play PvP it takes too long to connect with the opponent. If the opponent is not available then there should be an option to go back to the menu. And I would love if there are little more frequent updates in story.

I really like the way the game plays visually, and there are a bunch of variants to pull as far as characters. I just started playing this about 3 months ago, and I can see a clear gap between me and the players that either pay, or have been playing since it came out. Not really a good path for catching up, as a new player. Going to give it a few more months, and if pvp keeps going the way it is, ill be uninstalling simply because of the pay to play gap. Fun game as far as story mode goes tho.

Gameplay is very fun and intense as you keep playing, the voice acting is pretty well done, summons are fair and doesn't feel like you need to dump a bunch of money to get what you want. Online battles still need some fixes and before they up the level cap some missions were impossible and unfair but luckly, thats fixed. But besides that any fan of dragon ball can and will enjoy this, whether if they're a long time fan or a new one anyone can find something they like in this game.

Dragonball Legends is most definitely a five star game. This is coming from a huge fan that has stuck by Dragonball's side for a long time and also a life long gamer. It's not biased, it's just everything you could ask for in a DB game for mobile. The graphics are amazing, the mechanics are super fun, there's pvp and now they added co-op and honestly I really don't have any complaints. Personally for me this game is a easy 10/10 and I love it. Good luck on your pulls but most of all just enjoy.

Here we are, just another game that if you pay them hundreds of dollars you will be able to do something. Otherwise, be ready for a very frustrating game. The game has been getting progressively more and more unbalanced, to the point where the game isn't any fun anymore. The gacha doesn't even have a proper pity system either, so your efforts in the game don't feel like they are rewarded even if you don't get lucky. I believe the balance of the game needs a massive overhaul, as well as the gacha system.

Great game. Really fun. More action packed version of Dokkan battle. Only problem is the problem you have with all phone games. They always want you to buy stuff. Which is fine. And the loading is terribly long. But I am just not picking. It's still a very fun game.

Dragon ball had been such a good good game. The characters the powers all of it was awsome. And the excitement when you get the character you always wanted is the best. I dont have any negative comments on this game. I also appreciate how you update the summons every once in a while too. So many different characters and combinations that you can make into teams. And I also love the story mode, and how you developed shallot. His character is perfect for dragon ball.

I've rated over 100 games. My reviews are pretty accurate. This game is friendly for children and adults. The gameplay isn't that difficult. The game is extremely repetitive. You will have to pay to make any real progress against anyone who's been paying since the game came out. They do nerf PVP based on rank. Not a lot of options for the game and the story-mode takes forever to progress. You actually have to play every single story mission too to progress. Fun for those who love DBZ.

A fast paced, player controlled mobile DB game is hard to find and harder to enjoy, but thankfully Dragonball Legends pulls it off! With a mix of high octane battles, a nice roster of memorable characters to choose from, very little in the ways to force micro transactions, and a nice battle and ranking system, then game is almost perfect for the average gamer! Again, its almost however. Ive noticed that there is lag spikes when there is battles in both pvp and in story mode, and it seems that its hard to get certain characters from certain summoning events. I will say for featured and special summoning events, like the one we are currently in with Super Gogeta and Janemba, I find it ridiculous that we get more HE rankings (which is the most common) then EX (which is the middle ground between HE and SP). Plus there seems to be a ramp in level and combat skill needed in parts of the story mode that doesnt call for it. Example, one level youll be fighting enemies with a combined level of 220,000. Then all of a sudden your running into a level with a combined enemy level of 495,000. Thats a bit of a spike and can discourage players, and with a ten energy limit and a sparce Skip Ticket system this can leave people who like to train in grind not wanting to and finding something else Regardless, however, this does seem to be a fun and decent game with the perfect story and setting for a DB mobile game. Keep up the good work and please look into the complaints listed!

This game is well designed, plays well (with good wifi ofc), updates frequently, has no ads, and has a unique combat system. Amazing game! Probably the easiest to pick jp, but hard to master. This game is amazing, however theres two things that bug me about it, #1 the need for internet even if your doing the campaign or any of that, and number two at first you practically have no clue what half the stuff does, then when you learn it they decide to after give a tutorial. What I should say for this game, perfect the best dragon ball game i've been played, great graphics, the gameplay is better than some battle royale games, the skills, the events, the characters, all of them perfect, If I start talking about this game, I will never stop praising it, but i have one issue, people in ranking match better than us, i have so many warrios but it's nothing if i play againts super sayain god, and also the story mode is very easy, i wish fix it, and do other games

Very fun, and not pay to win , all you have to do is your daily challenges every day for two weeks toget a free 10x summon, but you get so much of the premium currency that you don't even need to play for that long to feel the progress, unlike other gatchas, I haven't spent money on the game and have really good, and new, characters, this is one gatcha you should check out.

This game is great, very neat! The F2P formula is great for the most part. once you get far enough into the game it becomes quite hard to play fully free and keep up with the meta but all in all it is still way better than most games.

This game has gotten awful over the years, it's incredibly pay to play and impossible to get cc from anything anymore. There is so much lack of content in this game it's just terrible for f2p players. If you intend to play just the storyline, then I suppose it should be just fine but given how much of the missions depends on multiplayer (PVP), that is where issues arise. Maybe its just me but this particular game also seems to be much harder to obtain characters in this gacha styled game, even when spending real money. As with every gatcha, you can't expect to get every high tier character you want without being willing to spend some cash, but you'll most likely be fine considering you get rewarded greatly for just playing the game.

Even that doesn't guarantee getting anything close to what you want. Earn 2000 crystals and end up with 20 heros and see how you feel.... On the other hand combat in PVE is fluid and well done. PVP still needs work though.

Every time I open the game I spend 80% of my time pressing menus, accepting "gifts", or reading "super important notices"... and by the time I finally get to playing the actual game, I feel so exhausted, I lose interest. I've tried this many times, I love Dragonball, and this game has all the potential to be good, but the clutter and over-gamification, over-questification just wastes all my energy on the wrong things.

I had put so much time and effort into the game and got lucky on alot of banners and pulled really good Sparking units. However, the other day I started up the app and it crashed. So, I decided to close it and re-open it. The next thing I know is none of my data was gone and I was doing the tutorial. So I contacted Bandai and let them know. Told them my Box, my level, my Name, etc. They then tell me "oh well. It's not our fault". This is unacceptable and I will no longer be playing this game.

Bandai Namco have really outdone themselves with this one. As a long time gamer and lover of DBZ, this game is the one I've been wanting for years! It's like a perfect blend of fighting and role playing, complete with a quality story line. I'm also super happy with the continued support and regular updates. there's never a lack of content, characters, quests, or missions to complete.

It's a fun game if you take it for what it is. There's a lot to do like events and limited time only game modes that makes this game worth playing if you're done with the main campaign. Chances of dropping UL characters, which is the highest tier, is pretty low. With that being said, there's a lot of p2w aspects to PvP. I avoid that part of the game and stick with solo experience. I hope the game will allow me to do that and enjoy the characters I have.

This game really reaches out to all of the DBZ fans and is the best on the market since you can actually see your favorite characters fight. My only issue is aside from multi summon rarely yielding an SP would be the Friendship meter can take really long to max out to learn an ability and it seems like there is no up side to him learning it, like a strength boost or a master/student boost and animation.

Love the game. I've been playing it for about the entire time it's been up. But lately I've been having the issue where the game just doesn't load. Either when I start it up or loading into the servers. It could take about 5 to 10 minutes, or even not at all. And when I try to load a battle, it just stops. I have a Samsung Galaxy Note 10+ and I have spent less than a third of my total storage. My wifi isn't the issue either, and I know that because I get sub 15 ping. Please fix this bug.

The game is great, don't get me wrong. I absolutely adore this game, but sometimes, even when I have a great WIFI connection, the game will glitch and send me to the home screen. Now this isn't a problem most of the time, because I'll be in a battle, but when the game boots me out when I'm doing a summon, especially an expensive summon... and I can't get the Chrono Crystals back, and I don't get any characters from that summon, that's when I get mad... please fix this glitch.

Its really great if you have a good enough phone,graphics,quality,network, the only down grade is see is the long tutorial but other then that it's actually a decent game, it gives you a lot of determination to get some characters, I mean, I know that there are some laggy people and people that don't let you do anything in a pvp match, but overall it's a good game!

Been playing this game over a year,not miss one day on my daily quest and games but recently this pass week or two the game has kept crashing on me and it's still is,bug glitch whatever it is,fix it. I even contact the Bandai headquarters and haven't hear back from them. I honestly play this to get all the characters and pass some time doing my daily and events. Apparently they fix the bug,so back to playing again more than usual.

Great game all around. Since Mar 2022 updates, can no longer get passed initial loading screen. Attempted to clear cache within andriod settings, clear cache & resync within game loading screen settings, uninstall & reinstall game & all updates, nothing has worked. Have not been able to play game since last week despite all troubleshooting, either mobile data or WiFi. :( Great game when you can play it.

Absolutely solid game. However, I wish that the controls were better and that we could access the game with Wi-Fi easily. Other than that I have no qualms with the game. Edit: They fixed the Wi-Fi problem quite fast. Edit 2: I am reducing my rating to 1 star because of the fact that the new Zenkai system is very f2p unfriendly and that it requires a lot of boring grind. Edit: I've come to terms with it

this game rules, even if you don't spend money on it. sure you might not have all of the best units, but you will have some good ones no matter what. while pay to win elements do exist, combat is based on skill; so in true Dragonball spirit, any difference in power can be overcome if you're badass enough. Flashy battle animations and competant gameplay mechanics make this game more addictive than the unit summoning, in my opinion. 5 stars, best mobile game I've ever played.

Now, I LOVE dbz, super, gt, etc. This game is perfect for any dragon ball fan, with unique character, unique playing style, and, a unique story mode! But I only have one addition to add for the developers, the in app purchase for the gem bot is something I have considered getting, but noticing that it only digs ups 30 Crystal's every 30 days, is pretty useless, considering I can get more than that for logging in for 2 days. I just suggest that you lower the price from 7.99, or increase crystals.

Absolutely amazing game. Graphics are insane, especially for a mobile game. Ultra rarity pull animations are GORGEOUS and the characters in general are amazing. The game is updated quite often keeping the gameplay fresh and clean. Only complaint I might have is how the in-game prices are very pricey, like 13 bucks for just 1,000 Chrono Crystals, but these might be to discourage pay-to-win because you can get the same amount through Story and Missions. Overall a beautiful game, keep it up Namco!!

I think that this game is amazing. I've played other mobile dbz games and this is the best one I've seen and played on mobile. One problem I do have though is the absolute struggle you have to go through to get Chrono crystals is crazy. I could spend over 5 days and not even get 1000 cc. I love this game as much as I love a video game that you got on a console or PC but the grind for cc is insane.

Gameplay wise I love the game the only problem is it needs more ways to earn gems. And not just events that'll take weeks and weeks to get 1000 of them. Also the rates at which you get the new characters needs to be buffed. I went through the Jiren banner 7 times and never got anything good. That's like 100$ worth or more. Other than those 2 problems the game is excellent.

It's a pretty fun game but with some of the updates I've noticed there have been lags/glitches with the attacks from my characters, i.e. they start an attack but move in slow motion compared to the character they fighting. Additionally, there is one level where the difficulty is completely out of sorts. It's immensely overly challenging compared to similar character strengths in the game. I'll play that level with the recommended strength or double the recommendation and it doesn't matter. Still nearly impossible to clear

I'm so sick of everyone trying to get rich off of every idea they have. This is a super limited phone game, with really only 1 thing to do. They charge you $40.99 for 2000 CC, which is 20 random characters. The possibility to pull a character worth anything is so low, I've spent hundreds of dollars without getting anything but heros, which is the worst available rarity. I'm not shaming the players. If you want to spend money on this, do it . . . but shame on the people who charge the price of a new, full, REAL game for the super low possibility at getting a new character that is only slightly different from what's already out. Your prices are FAR too high for a digital character that consumes no resources. I hope what happened in Belgium spreads to the rest of the world.

Dragon Ball Legends is an amazing game. I like the 3D Fighting and the animations of the available characters. I also like the Zebkia Awakening and the game is both fun and challenging to play as while also easy to play. Also, the amazing is great and my opinion and it runs smoothly almost all the time. Plus, with the addition with different card arts and title sign is an great idea to this game. Recently i lost some data from my characters, are you able to restore it. I greatly appreciated it.

If you love to grind for months and have nothing to show for it then this is the game for you. It used to be fun in the beginning when it first came out, but with time and with every update, the game got less and less rewarding. I spent 4k diamonds that'd I'd grinded for for months on and got 3 Extreme and 37 Heroic characters. Maybe, hopefully, they'll address this since the developers seems committed to the game and dedicated to the fan base.

Best legit mobile DragonBall Z game to date. With great fighting scenes, a new story to behold, characters that are neverending, multiple events and missions needing to be beaten, and then some. Though it could still use some tweaking here or there. Such as loading times, summon rates, event availabilities, etc. Nevertheless, still the best mobile anime game out here and still the best time killer. Thank you Bandai for this wonderful app.

I honestly love this game a lot. There is always so much to do and they have constant events for new summons or ways to earn in game currency. I just wish there wasnt so much push on purchasing things with real money. I know its mobile and it's to be expected but it sucks when you have friends who can blow money on a game and get everything while you have to grind and never get what you want. It's a gamble but the game can still be fun, I do have lots of good characters without buying anything.

Great game almost perfect it's awsome to see some manga i would love to have better server connections it lags with online live fights and can cause you to lose; game play is beyond amazing wish the summons would show me more love im lacking to be almost account level 100 and get stuck all the time i have even made in app purchases that didn't help. Is my luck that bad? They also give you and absurd amount of skip tickets i for one never use. Overall great time killer.

This used to be a great game. But it's consistently gotten worse and worse and worse every update. Although I do like the "free" zenkai system the fact you need certain characters to even have a chance at doing the quick battle up to level 70 is just not fair. Even trying to get the characters it doesn't matter, because Chrono crystals are hard as hell to get and you need the characters 7stars or above. They don't even make sense sometimes, just putting it there because it's new.

This game could be so much more if they added more than just characters for a limited amount of time I understand they gone is more intrigued and all that but I think from a replayability standpoint and a continuous need to go back keeping these characters around or having an incentive to finish the story other than a potential transformation would be well received.

Looking at it from a gameplay standpoint, it's simplistic, yet fantastic. Start with a roster of your favorite Dragon Ball characters, add a touch of card game elements, mix in arcade fighting gameplay and strategic balance, leave overnight, and you've got a fighting game sensation. Absolutely great game, despite my personal grievances with the summon system (I.E. Not always getting the characters I want), I still believe this is a fantastic game worhty of a five star rating!

Excellent game, I still believe that summons could be improved. I completely dislike the consecutive 10 summoning which uses 1000 gems. We should be guaranteed a sparking character otherwise, it's such a waste of gems. It would be nice if we could get, at most 3 guaranteed sparking characters everytime we did a consecutive 10 summoning. I also dislike the fact that we cannot get characters that were available in previous packs. There should be a pack always available where any character on the list is generated at random, that being all characters available. Once this part has been implemented I will give my deserving 5 stars, because honestly I do believe this is a great game. I've been a fan of this anime since I was 7 years old.

Let me just say: Amazballs. Ever since installation, the game has been great. From a much-needed level cap to more SP characters. Im not mad about the summon rates like everyone else though. The point is to get more play time, to increase ratings on gameplay. when people say it is luck based, this is true for summoning, and while I love it, most don't. Also, you should try harder to move people towards the customize screen for Shallot. I like the idea of changing his Special Arts. most never👀it

I love the graphic the most, one of the best anime style games based on graphics. As for gameplay, unique mechanisms, not too easy and not too hard. The grinding for this game is easy compared to other anime games. Level is easy to raise, equipment easy to grind. But, to max out the equipment is kinda a hassle. Playing during event help out a lot since they provide the required materials. The storyline, it is unique, and we can customise the main character skills and more. 9.5/10!

Great game, animations are good, characters have amazing detail and attacks. It's just... the game feels too p2w. Like at the time of writing this review, there is a summon going on where you can get an ULTRA (best rarity in the game) guaranteed, but it COSTS 7,000 CHRONO CRYSTALS!!! AND IT ONLY LASTS FOR 72 HOURS... Crystals are easy but hard to get. Sure, there are tons of events that give them, but the really rewarding amounts take a lot of time to get while the small amounts are easy to get.

I really enjoy the game! It has really good graphics (For a mobile game.) and amazing art! Also the way they handle Shallot is one of the best for a free to play unit. The Gameplay also feels really nice for a mobile game. There is one big problem though, the online. Even with the update the online can often be laggy and you can run into whales (People that spend an Extreme amount of money.) very often. That isn't fun because it's pretty much impossible to win.

This is honestly one of the best Dragon Ball games I've ever played! It has so much in it and so much to do that you'll never get bored of it. I love everything about this game except one thing... The controls are sometimes not responsive. Please fix this issue because while I was in battles, it doesn't respond sometimes to when I wanna dodge or teleport. Thank you for making this amazing game!

I love the game, the animations, the art, everything is just amazing. i love the fighting style, its very easy to control! one thing i've seen other people talk about a lot and i have experienced myself. when you play against the Al and use a skill arts combo, they just dodge in the middle of the attack. there's no way any actual player can do that! and when they use their combo against you, it just keeps going until the attack is over. so please fix that. overall, it's a good game. recommended.

I've played the game ever since 1st anniversary and I love the game but I've started to notice that the more stuff gets added less and less characters you get unless you spend $100 or more to get one new character, the game has just became a little more pay to win is all, which I won't stop palying but it'd be nice to get one good character once and a while. Fantastic game

Despite the game being really great due to storyline and characters, the players here are unhinged, they always use Ultras and unfair mechanics, I can't even play pvp peacefully, all I want is to use other characters rather than using overpowered characters, I only played for fun, but it doesn't matter about my choices and words, I have a really bad struggle in pvp. Great game anyway.

It's one of the beat mobile games yet to come, with much fun ahead! it's quiet challenging being F2P here and there, but this game's mechanics and drops just make up for it. Although it is hard getting what you want rather than what you need, it's ok overall, it's just missing some asp3cts, for example: there are only 2 ways to get equipments, both of which ways are very limited.

I've been playing since 3 days after the game released and I love dragon ball series. My only critical feedback I can give is that there should be a menu music option to change your music. I've been hearing the same menu loop for 3+ years. It's not good after so long, any extra selectable options would break the monotony

Fun action game with RPG elements... unfortunately updates are regularly extended and happen at poor times IMO (usually at the end of the daily reset, and lasts until or far past the reset time, so you get screwed if you try to do last minute summons). Example: as of me writing this a 2hr maintenance near the end of dailies was extended by 3hrs!

I've been playing this game since the release and it has come so far. with the introduction of new mechanics every so often and regular events, there's almost always something to do. as a free to play player, I disagree with others who say it isn't super friendly for them. not all banners are meant to be summoned on and if all events and exchanges are done, you're able to aquire somewhere around 7-10k cc minimum a month. save for units with longevity or miss out on them. some don't get it.

Large content, full of modes and events. Deep DB roster, the biggest in a dB game i have seen. Level up is very easy (a bit broken imo) for pve, but at the end it can be something optional. Gameplay is original. Mixes action and strategy in an ez way to get superfluously but hard to master (cancels, sidesteps etc). This makes it somewhat addictive and not very repetitive although exploiting certain things can make it. The cards rng can make the plot twist. Incredible graphics, good drop rates

I obviously like this game as its free,cheap in game items and the graphics.Dokkan battle was far worse than this game. It has apropriate plot and the new character shallot has good transformations. Only thing I would recomend is that you should add more of those ultra characters. My name is Rehaan(also in the game) suggest some tricks too. Peace.

It's fun and easy. But if your a dragon ball z fan like me than you will love this game. But it does have some downside such as when you have played the game for a while you get less ways to earn Chrono Chrystals and that gets rid of the the fun I getting a new unit. The summons also are kinda wonky because once you get a lot of units then it gets a lot harder to get new characters.

Love this game because I love Dragon ball! This game is all about the lore and it looks great doing it. 3 years in and still come back and play. Defently a much better time if you have the money to summon for the new hype characters. But great sales are around often and somewhat friendly to F2P. Only thing I could ask for is maybe different lobby/menu music choices? All and all love DB and this game.

This game is really great. It has great graphics for a mobile, a ton of content and depth. Don't listen to those who say it's pay to win, cause it really isn't. If you want a certain character, chances your going to get it, and the game provides many ways to get Chrono Crystals, which are what you use to get new or upgraded characters. Overall this game is really good you should definitely check it out

I love everything about the game except for a couple of things. I don't understand why all the chrono crystals are not only hard to collect but it's too expensive to buy them making it hard to perform summons and when you do summon it feels like 100 pulls won't get you a new Ultra or Legends Limited characters, but that's just my luck I guess, everything else about it is awesome and I wish there to be other games like this with different animes like BLEACH or Demon Slayer. Favorite Game to Play!

It is an amazing game. Feels way more immersive than Dokkan Battle. The card ranking is really well done, as well as the summoning mechanics. Some are saying the battling is pay to win but it's really not. If you're patient enough and take your time with a character, level them up enough, you can take on a really high level. I haven't paid a single cent in the game, and I have only lost when I do not take my time with the characters I use or they are a really low level.

Absolutely awesome. Deserves 5 stars. Graphics, Sound Design, and the Game Mechanics in general were just brilliant. Everyone says that this is a Pay-to-Play or a Pay-to-Win game. Slap a buzzer and scream wrong cuz it isn't. Many people have been playing this game since 2018. With lots of time on a game, of course your gonna get wrecked in a rating match or even a casual match. I haven't spent a single penny on the game and I have multiple 7 star characters. They also have the Dragon Balls.

Im not really a gatcha game person but I am having a lot of fun with DBL. There is a sizable amount of single player content with a story that has piqued my interest. The combat has enough depth to it that I actually feel like Im doing something and can make strategic decisions, with fights not completely dependent on having the best characters. The shop is expensive, but the game is quite generous with it's premium currency as long as you spend it wisely.

I mean, honestly this game gave me a vood amount of entertainment for a while and I had a lot of fun with it. I enjoyed playing as all the characters and leveling characters and fighting tougher bosses and in PvP, but after a while more and more updates resetting all my work upgrading my characters I just got sick of the needlessly added grind. (For example, raising the level cap.) I understand it's a money making tactic but that's also why I quit playing. We need a simple DBZ mobile fighter.

Very well made game. Controls are easy to use, beginners can play casually against AI, you get addicted to earning diamonds and drawing for more characters, and the system used makes it so even when you get a duplicate you have reason to be excited because it makes them stronger. The story is thought out and entertaining if you actually read it, I enjoyed it and am still enjoying it. Updates regularly with new content, always an event going on with more and different opportunities. This game is very well rounded and definitely not pay to win. Buying crystals can give you extra draws but that's about it, you can earn crystals very easy and they give them out for maintenance. This is one of the top 5 mobile games I've ever played. I am a very avid gamer especially portable & mobile, and this beats out Dokkan Battle by a landslide, and should be on every DBZ fan's device, and even those that aren't fan's can enjoy!

The game is amzing i love the game, but the summons can be kind of ridiculous but they are pure 100% luck. It can be pay to win but you don't really have to worry about that unless you play pvp. There are in game purchase items but they are CRAZY expensive and you might not even get the character you tried to get in the first place.

Simply Splendid....being a DB fan makes me feel happy playing this game coz it's just awesome. Although, i feel somethings missing somewhere. Like upto where I've played until now, art attacks cannot be countered, also the interaction is more with art attacks due to faster ki generation than usual. The combos on physical attacks is repeated which do not give much to please. Maybe this is what lacking in the game

It was a favorite from the start, It has just what I wanted in not just a Dragon Ball game, but also a mobile fighting game as well, good graphics, smooth mechanics and transitions, and amazing gameplay experiences.The story mode is also very exciting, and is one of the game's best features. It is, and always will be, my favorite game. I do wish the summoning chances were higher though, but overall, it's a great game.

I enjoyed alot of this game. I started about a month ago and the game guided me through the tutorial very well, it was a bit long however but I didn't mind that. Online was alot of fun, having to play against other people and some of my friends. However, there was some lag even with good internet. Overall it's a solid game if you're a dragon ball fan!

I've tried my damndest to spread how great this game is to others. With an amazing storyline, great character models, and a constant improvement on the game itself and it's mechanics it's one of the greatest Dragonball games in existence. Not to mention how communicative the developers are with their player base. All around 20/10, would reccomend, would play for days on end.

I really hate how after a certain level, it takes do much to get enough crystals, only to get the same boring characters that I never wanted to use. it's also really hard to get the higher level color spheres and things. I love this game but the chances of getting what you need or want are so slim it just drives me away.

Best Dragon ball game. Nice Story. I am only confused from so many duplicate of Carachters. I think there are more than 20 goku or 10 freezer. Would be nice to have less double not necessary Carachters. Give us the opportunity to fuse them and swap the Art card and costumes. Basically there is a Goku for every battle he made. We won't use all of them. C18 for example. 3 are enough. The rest is just clothes. Is it possible to add something to the Guild? For now is almost useless.

This game is one of my ultimate favs. There's always new missions, events, characters, and stuff to get, and I started playing daily so I wouldn't miss anything! It's awesome to try and collect all the characters you can and level them up with training and soul boosting. The games also lets players have their opportunities to fight with strong characters with really easy events to unlock and upgrade characters, and it's always fun to play through, Definitely recommend this game!

This is one of the most incredible games that I've experienced on the app store. The controls and graphics are exquisite, and the story is involving as heck. Just be aware that, with a little luck and a few training resources, you can CRIPPLE this game. In about 5 minutes, you can have a level 1,860 LSSJ Broly just as you start. Aside from that, this I would reccomend to everyone! Please play!!!

A simple and fun game for DBZ fans. In-game currency is easy to earn via gameplay, and it isn't pay-to-win. They're very generous with in-game currency, and often hand out large amounts of it as appreciation for the game's success. I've never felt pressured to buy anything. Sometimes, all the number of mechanics can feel overwhelming, however.

Great game! I would have given 5 stars if not for the newer update. It punishes newer players for getting new units. But the guild system and co op mode are great additions. Lastly the guild system needs more work. I accidentally lost my guild to an inactive player I meant to kick by transferring ownership to them because the kick and transfer ownership options are really close together. Also the same confirmation message displayed when trying to kick someone and transferring ownership.

Phenomenal DB game I've been waiting for a real licensed Z game. I didn't like dokkan battle at all. This game has it all. I have 10hrs in so far, still getting tutorials and game modes, options, etc, etc being unlocked still. The idea to have the game play in the air from the start was genius, instead of figuring out a flight control system. My idea would have been to let the fight decide where we wind up. Or give player option to knock Opponents upwards in the air or downwards to the ground. Ty

The PvP of this game is amazing. Though the experience is ruined if you don't have a good team and by absolutely broken units ,you can still have fun and play with your friends and have a good time. Game is still very P2W ( I mean it is a gacha what do expect). But some luck, a lot of farming and pulling on the right banners and for the right characters will go a long way. Enjoy!

It's a Great Game. Visually stunning and pretty fun. The only problem with it is there is a big difference when you're going for PvP since the Pay To Play Players have characters that are almost unbeatable while Players who doesn't have the means of getting the "crystals" are stuck with just luck. It's lucky to get a good character with the limited tickets that are given for free. While PTP Players basically gets the best Character while upgrading the other already OP Characters in the process.

I love this game except that sometimes it takes forever to load. And sometimes they upgrade the characters too much that it makes the fighting too easy wasting the energy bars which are needed to fight. And sometimes when I win a battle it will kick me out of the game and say that I have a network issue. Please fix this. Other than all this, this game is great. I love the drawings. KEEP IT UP!🙂

The game is great, however there are some issues, as any other game would. First up is the chances on getting event/sparking characters in summons, and the pricing for them. Most summons are way too pricy and have really low odds for sparking/event characters, making them a gamble that you'll almost always lose, for the price of all of your crystals. Another issue I have is with the rare medals. They are extremely hard to get unless you do pvp, so you can't upgrade either event characters.

STAY AWAY FROM THIS GAME, IT'S NOT WORTH IT. For every 1 step this game takes forward, they end up taking 2 back. It's now gotten to the point that simple inputs like vanishing and swithcing won't register even in a match with perfect connection. And this isn't just me, I watch multiple content creators on Youtube and I hear more and more of these complaints as time goes on. Not to mention that they've been pushing out multiple high rarity characters in quick succession with no actual content.

Great game honestly, pull rates provide a challenge to get units you want. There is always a challenging game mode no matter how op you get, which means it will remain interesting. Gameplay is cinematic in true db fashion. I pre registered and I'm still not bored with the game. One bad side of the gane is that the in game purchases are ridiculously expensive. Good game, good graphics good longevity.

Honestly this game has changed drastically for the worse. Back then it was easy to get in game currency with constant events that felt refreshing and welcoming to grind out. Now it's turned into a money cash grab and the only way to progress characters that are actually worth getting is by purchasing outrageous prices for in game currency that barely gives you enough to pull two times and still have a chance of not getting the character that you want because the drop rates are ridiculously low.

The latest version is working, but seems to run a bit rough. There are odd things that happen such as when you win a round it won't give any energy needed to soul boost and gives a message unable to require. Also controls are still glitchy example you select an attack or power up and the character doesn't do anything. Before the update on the 12th the game was almost perfect.

Dragon Ball Legends has always been a fun and exciting game. I've been playing since release and it's still my favorite mobile game to date. The game is constantly being updated and improved, new features being added, and though it's free to play, it will make you want to grind out to get the next new batch of characters being released. The game is great but my only issue is contacting support about in-game issues - good luck trying to get ahold of somebody to talk to or even give a reply back.

Absolutely great game. Especially if you like any on the Dragonball series. For my personally i wish they could do something about the controls as it feels sometimes like it doesn't react or do as you wish. For the rest great game it gives you a real Dragonball feel! Unfortunately after the last update the game keeps crashing after the title screen on my Samsung Galaxy S10. So can't recommend it until they fix that bug!

Not a bad game at all. I enjoy playing it. However, constant communication error occurs when not using wifi. I have a galaxy s9. Had to download a different app to open it outside of wifi. Then there's the PVP. From what I'm told, everyone you play up to rank 13-ish is NPC. Great for getting used to the mechanics, but once you break that thresholds, you will potentially get paired with fighter after fighter way beyond your power level. At 300k, I was pinned up against 800k and 700k about 3 matches in a row. At the end of the day, it's a great app. Mechanics, characters, abilities and all. Just connection errors for certain phones, mine included, and the PVP ranking system.

The game overall is awesome for casual players and crazy dragonball fans! It's fast pace and really gets the adrenaline running. The game is fluid when there aren't any lag issues while playing pvp. As for the art, it just really brings something else to the table compared to other mobile games. When it comes to grinding souls, zeni or exp, it doesn't feel overwhelming and is truly a great game! 5* for me!

Curious. I wrote a review already. Here it is again: The game is mostly enjoyable. I say mostly, because some battles are WAY too stacked against the players to the point of absurdity. The rewards are too low to be worth any effort. I understand that games needs to present a challenge to feel worthwhile but in some battles it's like fighting characters who are using cheat codes. Games are for relieving stress, not causing it. Please consider reducing the difficulty levels and I'll give 5 stars.

The thing I Hate about it is that you can't transfer an account after 24 hrs. I transfered an account then my phone died. And the transfer didn't save so I have to wait 24 hours just to sign in to my account. Another thing I Hate is that the game takes up to much space. That's really annoying and I lose some of my space on one game. Otherwise the game is good 👍👍👍

I've been playing the game since it came out and have never missed a log in. From the time I've opened the app, it's had me hooked. Love the gameplay and the graphics, along with the multitude of players to choose from. Whether your a die-hard Dragonball/Z/GT/Super fan or just looking for a fun game to pass the time, you wont want to put it down. ☆☆☆☆☆

This is by far the best anyone could ask for in a mobile DB game and more! The only thing it's lacking is slightly more diverse tap combat. In other words, it would be cool if you could do a little more when tapping the screen to attack. Maybe a longer combo string or a follow up attack at the cost of ki or something? Just a suggestion, but still, one of the coolest dbz games around, and I've played them all 😬

The game is pretty good. You're given lots of things from the start, and it never feels like the game wants you to spend money. The art is incredible, the game runs super well, and most of all looks great. My main issue is the pvp. It's ATROCIOUS. Half the time you'll pretty much just not be able to play the game because someone has you in an infinite combo with no chance for you to escape. Sometimes there's no difference between me trying to escape and me just setting down my phone. It's awful.

It's a fun app with a decent story! The controls are easy to use and a good experience overall. Some the events are a little repetitive and the summons to acquire new characters really uses up too much Crystal's. The chances of you getting decent new characters are so low that it would be a waste to spend your hard earned Crystal's. You should eliminate hero level characters from master pack summons all together so the players who actually use 1000 Crystal's don't feel robbed

It is a great game, really enjoyable and if you have the time, you can grind it as well. Only ONE Thing: Whenever I try to play while I'm on my mobile data, the screen stays on connecting for 20 min and doesn't connect after no matter how many times I retry. But when I'm on WIFI, the game loads up perfectly fine. Fix this please. If this isn't within your game please tell me how to fix it.

The game is really fun but it can feel slow at times when trying to get new characters, maybe add an option to choose how many summons you want to do at once instead of have just the 2 options of 1 and 10 at once. This would really be helpful for players who grind this game to get new characters and for the others who have little time on their hands to play games. ------------------------------------------- TL;DR Add a dropdown menu to select the amount of summons the player wants to do at once.

Ok so the game is very good, as in there are almost no glitches except sometimes when it lags but that's about it. But, there is one thing I don't like nor do I get why it's in the game, the you must wait 24 hours before you can transfer to another account, please devs I do not get the reason this is in the game and the error code keeps on appearing and it's making it to were I cant play for most days. Please remove this feature or at least tell me what it's purpose is

Great game over all. Only complaint I have is with pvp. There always seems to be some sort of delay between vanishing and attacking. I'll have ample amount of time to vanish and swipe to do so but it doesn't let me vanish and i get hit anyway. With attacking, I can finally complete a vanish step or have an opportunity to attack, i'll select an arts card but my character will stand there like an idiot and let the other player win.

Yea. This game was fun at first. Until you run out of ways to get in game currency. The game has a major pay wall behind it. I wouldn't say it's pay to win but it sorta is. New characters have a 1% chance of being pulled. If you wanna have a chance to even get the character you want. Have fun wasting over $100 for in game currency and still can't get the character you want. But even with the major pay wall it's still fun and enjoyable. This is a really fun gacha game.

The game is amazing, but it crashes a lot. Whenever I summon more cards or when I start a fight, it crashes. I figured I could deal with it because I can start again right where I left off, but now I can't progress in the story. In book 4 chapter one, whenever I kill the first saibaman, the game crashes. This means that I can't unlock multiplayer battles and duels. Will give 5 Stars once the problem is solved

This game has a learning curve to if you want to be successful in PvP and the skill ceiling is very high for those who want to put the time in to be the best (which I think is a positive) and the PvE is now pretty good. They did away with one pay to win system, but then replaced it with another which is overtaking the game. It's fun, but it's turning too pay to win

Story and graphics are both phenomenal, with some of the writing easily surpassing some of the weaker points of the actual series. Characters act like they're supposed to and everything looks fantastic. Unfortunately, the monetization scheme has become completely unreasonable and seeing as how people pushed back on that they've increased "the grind" to make it feel like spending money is more worth it. Above all else, this game has become a chore. Play it for the story, but don't spend money.

I'm dropping my initial four star rating, nearly every time I summon the game crashes. What's the point of playing a game when its prized mechanic barely works? Not only that, but there's no way to get the wasted chrono crystals back, without playing the story mode for hours, or spending money that is. Better off holding onto your chrono crystals until the game's fixed. Don't get me wrong, I love the game. And I am willing to wait for a fix, it's just frustrating how janky the summons are.

Great graphics, gameplay, and story line! The only small issue is the PVP. It seems if the opponent has a weak connection, they are at an advantage. It slows gameplay and makes it almost impossible to dodge attacks. This was not enough problem for me to not give this game a 5💫 review though. Everything else is beyond amazing on it's own. NOW DROP SOME MORE STORYLINE CHAPTERS!

Overall, pretty good. PvP can be annoying when losing opponents quit or disconnect. But there are plenty of offline options to focus on, for the most part. I say for the most part because, once you've had the game for quite a while, past events will return. If you've completed them, there's not much to do anymore. All the characters are great and are unique with their special moves and skills.

It's an excellent game, it would have been better if the game display could be rotated from a portrait to a landscape view. The developers should also add an exit button in the searching for pvp opponents page because sometimes it takes very very long to find an opponent and there is no way to exit that page or to go to the previous page. Other than that it's a great game.

Great graphics, love the opening video. It's great to be able to pick English or Japanese voice actors. I wish the game would let you know the challenges during tutorials, and let you meet them. Hard to accomplish goals when the game walks you through the choices that aren't the goal. Edit: Tried emailing support and only got a generic message back, the same message word for word 3 times. It didn't solve or address my issue I asked about. Support is of no support.

I think the game is great! It's fun, has good visuals, and has a huge player base in case you want to do online matches. Now, onto the downsides. Sometimes, there's a bit of desync with the audio, causing the static like undertone to be played until you close the app or play the story mode.
