Matches lag a ton, the game throws way too much at you sometimes, but I guess that's part of the challenge. The pulling rates are decent, though there's a bit of grinding involved. 7/10.

Amazing graphics and good simple gameplay I didn't think that i would like it in the beginning but I got adected to it now xD... However it gets extraordinary hard to level up as you progress through the game, I'm pretty sure that they'll solve this issue in the next updates. ***update They solved the issue lmao! I reinstalled it two years later during the second anniversary and it's still amazing and flawless, the art, the graphics, the gameplay it's all amazing.

Graphics and controls are honestly great. The tutorials are clear and simple so there's no problem in trying to figure out what to do. Once you start playing you want to keep on going to win more characters and finish the rest of the story it has prepared for the players. The game does have its flaws when it comes to pvp with friends and with other people. Also its way of getting good characters when it comes to summons in a way is pretty ass but it does help one get distracted for a while

Dragon Ball. I'm a huge fan and love the series as well as the games. The combat system is great and so are the graphics. Events? Awesome. However. I wanna talk about rates. The rates to get competitive Sparking units are often times terrible. I will end up spending 100 dollars on a banner to get shafted over and over again. If the rates were a bit higher for featured units, it would be perfect but that issue is a serious setback and makes the game unappealing to new players. 3/5 gatcha rates.

It's something that you dont usually come across. But after playing the game for a while (three months to be exact) and you start getting good items and all of that. You get into the groove and start liking it. The graphics are better than most games, reminds me of Raging Blast 2 if it was for mobile. The controls is simple. You don't have to buy things often since you just get things from up-to-date events that goes on from time to time. It's a solid performance.

Updated 06/23/22. I found a way around the game crash bug, but it's something that should be way more heavily pushed in the news with troubleshooting. Literally upon my first troubleshooting step I fixed the issue. The fact remains that these solutions don't work for everyone, so a patch should definitely be addressed. Outside of that, still a great game but not an amazing anniversary. For new/returning players, there is definitely a trove of content, but for the true gamers what a let down...

Fun game with great characters but there's 1 BIG issue u need to fix. U have so many characters u make it basically impossible to level up any of the great ones u get. Time and time again u will think u got a multiple so I can level up whoever. Only to end up let down finding out ur not leveling up its just a slightly different version of that character u also won't be able to level. AFK had this problem but has now fixed it with a elite selector u can use a few X a month. And its been great!

Really love the game. Haven't played anything else in a while! One thing I think should be fixed: on pvp, sometimes in between battles the screen is completely black while the game is loading. You don't know if the screen is off or on. Please add a logo to that screen! So I don't t try to awake the phone, thinking it was sleeping, only to actually put it in standby, cut connection and lose the match!

This game has two major problems right now. One, it's very unfriendly to free to play players. Two, it's very monotonous. They have been putting out the same rehashed events over and over, and it's a mind numbing grind to try and complete other content like the adventures. Edit: Improved my rating to 4 stars. They've definitely added more to do and the adventure grind isn't nearly as painful. And while it's gotten a little better, it's still pretty rough for f2p players.

So,... this game has two sides. First the gacha and related stuff: The Gacha can be pretty forgiving and the rates for "SSR's" is pretty high. There is a wide range of units which are usable, except if you want to get to a high rank in pvp. Then it quickly evolves to either P2W or you need to be really lucky to keep up. But you can get pretty far if you're F2P. Second the gameplay itself: It's extremely good imo. It's amazing how deep the combat is for such a relatively simple control scheme.

I personally like the game, it's just that you get bored easily. The game is tempting you to win so if you lose you'll probobaly rage. It includes no ads a great game but, i have a problem whenever i log in it shows events when i clicked don't show again, another issue it takes it's toll for to much space. Also, the game is a bit to easy in story and events so i would prefer something harder then "Scream" Also, i think you should unlock friendship points more easily.

This game is my favorite mobile game. I always find myself gravitating towards it compared to the other apps I have. It does get annoying at times and you want to take a break from it but after a while you just want to jump back in. I had it at 5 stars but I felt like it has it's moments where you want to continue but the whole buying crystals or energy gets in the way. But that's rarely since the game does sometime make it easy for you to get them so you can continue.

I gave this game 5*s because I didn't like that it said 4*s was that I liked it. I do love this game, there are just a couple issues. For starters, sometimes when you're choosing characters for battle, after you submit the game will freeze and you'll have to restart the game. Also, I do believe they make soul shards alittle too unaccessible, but that problem isn't as urgently insisted. This game deserves 5 stars, and I hope to see plenty of updates in the future.

I love the game being able to unlock so many characters and building the strength for my favorite fighters but I feel like with the past few updates the loading in the game has been taking forever and is somewhat annoying and some times I get a black screen when trying to load into the story mission which then I have to close the app and wait on the long connecting and load times just to get to the menu. hopefully this is something that is fixed.

The game is really user friendly whether your free-to-play or pay-to-play. The UI is really good and not to mention the stunning graphics. Update: Now I still frequently play the game and sometimes purchase items. But it is no longer the free to play friendly game it once was. The amount of money required for crystals isn't fair in the slightest you defiantly don't get your money worth. But with that being said you can still have fun without paying.

I love it. It's got the artwork I love, plus some of the old art styles for nostalgia. And the original story with original characters is awesome. I love that it has a slight gacha system (with awesome animations), but balances it out with an incredibly detailed combat system that's easy to use. I also love the detail to the training system, how it gives you many stats that are useful, and gives you options like gear and abilities, all of which you can boost!

Graphics are pretty nice, content added frequently, but if you don't have really good WiFi/data speeds, you aren't gonna have fun, due to the game simply not being able to register your inputs fast enough or even at all at times. The multiplayer is only sort of functional. Co Op works well enough but good luck finding a match. PvP can also have trouble matchmaking, but then you get into a match and there are still connection problems. Good if you have fast WiFi but irritating without.

This is a game I have spent alot of time playing. Through countless ups and downs ( most of the downs were caused by jaco) and really enjoyed the constant new characters but the game doesnt come without some faults. Equipment in this game is stupid and needs a rework. The amount you get and the time it takes to go through and sell or upgrade is insane. The worse thing is you can't just ignore it either because it stops most functions in the game when it is full. Good game overall tho.

I would love to see new movement variety. I appreciate the simple movement,but it gets very predictable. I often avoid online play mainly because of it. Maybe add the ability to block attacks instead of vanish from them completely. I would love to see movement similar to Dragon ball Xsoverse 2. Instead of in the air most of the time let us move on the ground and explore and a freeplay mode. This game has potential to do alot of things.

This game is very fun. Very addicting once you get the hang of it. The events are what really make this game rewarding. It definitely helps that the events are subtly guiding you in how you should be playing. They could reduce the cooldown for mission energy though. 😒 - 6/27/18 I just hopped back on a few weeks ago and, here I am 2 years later, the game feels like its gotten much better since its launch. BUT.. they changed OG Brolys' voice to some adolescent teen voice playing tough... NO!

I really like this game, graphics are on point, story is well done and stays interesting and it's free to play. Loading screens take a little long but for a mobile game but I dont think it could be any better than this. However, when it comes to the prices of crystals at the store, $40.99 for 2000 chrystals?! That's only 2 summons and you don't get the character you want most of the time when you summon, don't spend $ on it, seems like a rip off. It's a great free game to play honestly. 9.9/10

The story missions and events are a ton of fun, but the PVP is pretty terrible. There's potential there, but there's really no point in playing outside of gathering "adventure" missions. It all comes down to luck, and hoping the matchmaking system favors you. I've literally been matched up with characters that I killed with a single Strike attack - no strategy or skill involved. The gameplay has some Rock Paper Scissors dynamics, but it's all undermined by the lack of fair battles. The single player AI isn't any better, as during later difficulties it becomes blatant that they're reading your inputs, and they have a reaction time that's instantaneous.

Game has improved leaps and bounds, crystals still cost a lot but there are many deals and new ways to get more while playing. (Appreciated) as of late it's constantly crashing, I'm not sure what that's about plz look into. Overall I like the game. *Game will crash on title screen please fix. I'm missing all my daily rewards and stamps because the game crashes before you can even get in please help.

I have been playing the game for a few months now, and I have started playing the game because of how incredible the art was, how much content was brought out, and how friendly the game was to all sorts of players(no matter if they're paying for content or not) however, the game has admittedly taken a turn, but not for the better. The game has been running into long dry periods where content and rewards are scarce; from getting fresh new stories and rewards that gave players the incentive to play continuously on a weekly basis, the game has turned into a desert where players have to scrape the bottom of the barrel just so they can get crystals(which isn't even enough for a multi summon anymore, mind you) Another thing is that the PVP system has become a far cry from its former self; from being an environment that requires the players to strategically play and at often times to create new fun ways of playing, it has evolved into an uninspiring grindfest that's filled to the brim with bugs and exploits that take the fun out of the game.

I've always been on and off with the game, but I enjoy coming back to it. My main issue is in PVP. When someone with a weak connection plays, they get the advantage over someone with great connection. It makes trying to dodge their attacks impossible and when you attack them, you can't tell they've dodge until they're already beating on you, so you waste 2 or 3 cards and a ton of Ki on something that isn't even happening.

I really like this game, graphics are great but i do have a couple of downfalls to the game: Too many players that some how manage to cause lag when attacking, but when they attack runs smooth. Reporting is pointless, there is no option to describe the situation and the few options they give to click on are pointless. Unable to communicate with guild members is a downfall too. Also I feel that the in app purchases are really high, i find it to be way to expensive for little in return.

I love it, though would be better with create your own characters and give certain powers.... Just recently had to start all over. Something happened to my phone and it uninstalled and i couldnt regain any of my saved info. Tried to recover it all but it failed to. Just finished the story mode again and working on getting my other characters back. Still enjoying the game. Just wish there was a better way to save progress and get it back.

The graphics are AMAZING!!! My only issue w/ it is it's too detailed. There are sooooo many different modes, features, add-ons, etc that the game introduces to you immediately. It's pretty overwhelming IMO. I'm still trying to understand the gameplay 😂. Overall, it's worth the download if you're a DBZ Fan & have the space on your phone.

The controls are easy enough to get down yet mastery is illusive with them. It makes things interesting. The amount of depth in the combat system is crazy. I now have a far better yet still incomplete knowledge of the mechanics but I don't care. I get it well enough to own. All the characters and little add ons is emence. 100k% worth it. The game keeps getting deeper and deeper with layers that keep being added on. Normally that kind of thing ruins a game. The devs think before they add.

I get hyped everytime an original character is introduced, so having Shallot there is amazing. The gameplay is simple and fun, but honestly, the best part is that there's a "lite" version of the app, which doesn't take up as much space and I love that! But, there's a problem I keep having and that's that the game will basically not launch and stays in a "black screen of death", as I've heard other people refer it as. And quite honestly, that just takes away from how great the game is and it doesn't help it at all, cuz if I want to keep playing, I have to uninstall and install it again.

It's a great game, been playing it every day. But still there are something that I want to criticize about this game. It's about the equipment system. It would be much better if each equipment still stick to the character even they on/off the party or even move to another party. It's too bothersome to keep re equip the equipment every time a party member on/off the party

Really good game for being a phone app. Great graphics, good controls and fairly easy to get the hang of but I'm still learning as I go. Not the kind of game you can rush which is cool cause it helps you learn slower and take in more. My only problem with it is there are some players that have a certain tactic that makes it almost impossible to beat them. It's almost cheating in my eyes and makes it no fun to play PvP when I get keep getting spammed by a single method by a single character

Once I got the hang of things in Dragon Ball Legends, it was one of the most addicting games I've ever played, and that initial learning curve isn't too bad with all its extensive tutorials. By its nature, though, every in-game expense is a :gamble:. Take care when it comes to where and what you spend your resources on. Because they are so integral to gameplay, the wrong choice will have you quickly regretting it. All around: very fun / very expensive, but if you love Dragon Ball, very worth it.

Cool gameplay, nice graphics, the controls seemed weird at the beginning, but you quickly adapt to them. Getting currency seems easy so far, we will see how bad the rng is. The story is meh atm, hopefully it picks up. Zero crashes on my S9 so far, so it seems well optimized. Battery consumption is good as well. It does feel a bit lonely though, maybe add some multiplayer events to hype it up.

It is a very good game especially when it's on the mobile platform. However I have an issue and I think I speak for everyone else when I say that there is not enough Chrono crystals(game currency) to get more units and it's honestly kinda irritating because then you are forced to buying and it's not cheap. You get a boat load of Chrono crystals in the beginning of the game but as you level up it gets harder to find things to do to get Chrono crystals .Other than that it's a great game!

So far this game is really fun! The story is entertaining. The dodging has been giving me some issues but nothing that has hindered the gameplay. 1.2.2020 Still here. The game has definitely gotten better. I like where it's going. New transformation characters, more ways to get crystals, characters you can actually get by putting time into the game, reasonable level up systems, co battles, guilds and much more! Hopefully more to come.

It's a game that pays great fan service to true DB fans young and old. Great animations, smooth gameplay, and simple interface. That said, I HATE games that have a timer with a pay to play mechanic with multiple in-game currencies. Thats always a warning sign for me. Microtransactions SUCK. Anyway, I realize that I can wait for the timer, but I'm a bit too hard-core for a game like this. I dint want the action to ever stop. So once I complete the main campaign, I'll probably delete the game.

Amazing, not that many mobile games make it this far in quality of gameplay and graphics. This is a potential of a master piece in future updates that I can't wait for. I feel like the story will just add on and so will new characters, and for being a game that has just practically released it is having a great startup. I want to be able to look back and tell people. "I remember when this game came out" (;

After a few updates the summons seem a bit better and the double and triple soul drops have tremendously helped with both character addition and boosting. Building a team for pvp has been incredible, however there are games where I have been caught in a endless loop. If there was a better way to counter it then maybe I'd get a chance at a opening but I'm not able to make a move in some games. Overall it's a great game, I've been playing nonstop since launch and it's alot better now than it was

I've played for quite a while now on and off and I love the new content they keep coming up with since I first started in the beginning of its release. The crystal currency is a joke to purchase, since it costs far more for a small stack in game then any other game I've played.. but overall it's a fun game! I hope they fix the chronos crystal prices to get around the fixed character summoning.

Overall, Pretty good game. The battle system is fun, the characters are fun to collect, and it has tons of things to do. (P.S, To do a vanishing step on chromebook, just use your left finger to hold down on the mousepad and swipe with your right finger in the wanted direction. If you get the timing down, you'll have no problem.)

Worth the wait for sure! This game has incredible graphics; tight controls that are simplistic and easy to grasp, yet still requires some degree of skill to use effectively; and a decent story to support all the battles, even if the character development and game-shaking events feel a little bit forced. Edit: stay away from PVP though if you treasure your wallet/sanity. It's a ptw wasteland out there. (Posted when Dragon Ball Legends first came out. Edited because the original was too long)

I love the game but recently I have had issues where it won't let me play leaving me on the retry or return to home screen. This seems to be a critical error that won't fix itself even with app closed and phone restarted. my phone is a pixel 2 xl and I've never had issues before. I've spent a little bit of money to support the game, so I would love a response from tech support. otherwise awesome game.
very entertaining and fun to play with friends or family

I love this game and the amount of free sparkings is insane. However, it is a lot of grinding for them. Please increase the amount of medals. The gameplay is awesome but, we need a block button. I appreciate being able to lvl without tier restrictions. The drop rates could use some improvements. But, I got lucky with the ssb kaioken Goku banner. The login rewards are pretty dope. My only issue is that the game does crash at times. Which can get annoying. But, reducing graphics helps and lite mode

The game is amazing, especially the graphics but I kind of wished I could play the main lead as a girl tbh. I also have trouble going back to the game, it freezes and continues to load but won't work unless I restart it. It's frustrating playing PvP, because the app randomly closes completely (like I get kicked out), afterwards it takes more than 3 minutes to find another player. Afterwards the game tells me it's my fault, which is vexing.

This game excels in many aspects, for the most part the controls handle very well and the graphics are eye catching with easily differentiating indicators of attacks. The one thing I would love to see more of is characters and the very well written story they have come up with. EDIT: The game has become way too grindy.

It's good to level up and fight against players and so many different characters but I have a few problems. The matches are sometimes unfair, times of much higher power level players have more powerful characters than others do. When you lose connection and are out of the match, it counts as a loss, some do it on purpose but if it happens accidentally then it is not fair. The last thing being is how laggy it is sometimes, it might be my phone but the game just lags on its own.

Great DB game with a few problems here and there. Legends boasts a large roster of characters with unique abilities and synergies. Its graphics are similar to Xenoverse, and the story churns out slowly but is rather unique. Online can be a little dull though, when the opponent's main tactic is always the same. Like tic-tac-toe, the outcome can sometimes already be decided within the 1st few moves. Also, some events require very specific units to complete them, despite its nature as a gacha game.

If the game would have been made in landscape mode then the gameplay and controls would have been much better. You can't make it a landscape mode now so I suggest that you can give us an option on customising controls For example give us a choice for making the controls smaller so it takes up less space. You can also add a joystick if you want. Test it out to see whether it improves the gameplay or not. If joystick is not added even then it's ok. Keep up the good work and please make it available for Asian countries like Pakistan India etc.

It's a great game, and one of the few free ones that don't feel like it forces you to spend money to keep up. Only two reasonable complaints. 1. There is no blocking. It's silly to think of the DB world where blocking is not important. 2. The most annoying thing is the autoplay AI. It is practically worthless. Using it, I regularly lose battles where my team has 2-3 times more battle power. Even battles that should be just a couple hits to put them down seem to drag on forever.

Despite what follows I still recommend this game as it is fun and engaging with gorgeous art. My issues are with energy and dodge. You have 10 energy to spend on activities, but all save book one cost 2 or five energy. After the challenges are met in that storyline there's really no reason to play them again, so that means less time spent with the game. The dodge has become a source of frustration for me. I've seen the AI dodge limitlessly, even at times when I know the game would not let me. I've also noticed players execute questionable dodges in pvp. I've tried to do the same ones without success. I'm not talking about switch-dodging or the like. I mean dodging in the middle of an arts card attack, or dodging after getting hit by one, which I have still not been able to do or even get a dodge warning. Only two issues I have, but they do not diminish the quality of the game. Sours my enjoyment a bit, but I think where this game really shines is the beautiful art of the character cards. The combat is good one you get the hang of it, and the story is neat especially if you're a DBSuper fan like I am.

Pretty fun game overall. Good graphics, lots of characters, and fairly balanced. The lag is unreal at times, and makes it almost unplayable. Getting high level characters almost demands constant grinding or climbing the paywall. I can't say I'd recommend it to others, but it does have the trappings of a very solid mobile game if the difficulty spikes were brought down a bit.

I love the game, I really do. But the reintroduction of Shenron, and the fact that most of the U.S states, and even some other countries are in lockdown situations, there is a massive problem with scanning for the balls. If you could address this by making it not necessary to scan, or decreasing the amount of times before scans, it would be greatly appreciated.

For the most, it can be a fun game. However, I do happen to get regular crashes which cause me to shut my game down and start over again. The other annoying fact, I love collecting (trying) new characters but it seems nearly impossible. All I get are Saibaman or Jaco. I would love some decent characters. Anyways I'm starting to feel frustrated over the lack of chance of getting anything decent so I am putting the game away for a while.

Great controls, smooth HD graphics that don't glitch the game, and a epic storyline, and it doesn't really require in game purchases to get the characters you want like other games I LOVE THIS GAME!!! Everything I said is still true...I have never been a mobile gamer, but I've been playing this game for over 2 years now, that's saying something for me 😂

I still enjoy playing this game but I definitely thought by now they would have increased the efficiency of the dodging. I mean the reaction time for the combat is so slow its ridiculous. I know it's not a connection or device issue because I have tried it with others. like when I swipe to dodge, he should instantly dodge that attack not wait 2 seconds, get hit and take on a chain of attacks because the reaction time is too slow. I still love this game and intend to play

No game has ever had me obsessively checking news over it. Very impressed with whats coming, though the order of some banners can be a little confusing as well as the choices behind the new characters and missions could give a little more crystals as rewards but all in all, its addictive, fun and has a lot of potential for longevity. Highly recommend!

The game is great! I only have 2 things I wish to address. One Is the ranked battles sometimes seem to be a bit unfair. For example, it gets really annoying when I get 10 battles in a row with people and their team is twice as strong as mine. It just isn't fun since I don't even have a chance if winning. The second thing is, it seems really difficult to get chrono crystals. You only get them once for every level. It would be good if we could get at least 10 chrono crystals for replaying a level.

Its gameplay mechanics are fantastic. The story is well thought out. The characters all have their own mechanics making every character feel different from one another even if it is the same person such as having one goku feel completely different to another. One major down side is that the summoning rates are quite bad at the moment. Another down side is that it can feel like its pay to win at moments, but it's also quite okay if your simply free to play. Overall it's a great game.

Love the game but for the past few days ( nearly a week) my game keeps crashing. It can be annoying. It will either freeze at the title screen or just decide to close it's self. Don't know if it had something to do with the update or not because my phone would always run the game well. Update: it's not as bad anymore but it's still happening, usually when I battle or summon.

Wonderful game, nice graphics, nice gameplay. PvP matching system could be better. I often face people who have lower levels than me. This is a good thing for me while not so good for them. Perhaps, matching should be made according to battle points and team power levels. Other than that, I loved every aspect of this game. EDIT: The game has become unbearably pay to win and it's so much harder to get good characters now...

Been playing since launch and held off on a proper review for a long time but in short, the game is fantastic. It has a good battle system in which you and choose attacks from different "cards" such as strike, ki volley, special, and a skill card, on top of that you can swipe to dodge and SP rarity characters even have unique attacks. The game is regularly updated with new events and characters from Dragon Ball/Z/GT/Super and even movie characters. Some microtransactions but P2W isn't necessary

I love this game. It is easy and uncomplicated. I understood the game after a few minutes of playing freely. It is easy but also difficult. There are many challenges and missions. My feedback is that you Bandai should make the missions a bit more clear or at least have an explication that goes further into detail when you click on it. Also, when you click on the mission and there is the button that says "start", I wish that that button would take you to a location to start your missions more. 👌

If your a fan of the Anime, would definitely recommend. Visuals are great, gameplay is too. Alot of events and story content to keep you invested. Ad-free. Some of the challenges can be a bit tedious when your either too high level and constantly drawing the wrong cards but that is only a minor inconvenience. Overall, game is amazing, keep it up.

I've tried at least four times to like this game, but it is just way too overwhelming with all of the things it throws at you. There are about 18 pop-ups I have to dismiss before I can even get into the menus, and even then, it's throwing all kinds of markers at me to claim rewards, train, and buy things. Just give me the rewards. I don't want to spend more time in the menus than in the actual game. I'm not even sure I can rate the gameplay as you rarely can even figure out what is next to do.

The game is amazing! The only problem I have with it is the swipe system. While you can swipe to move left or right, that also happens to be the instant transmission input as well. Sometimes in battle the swipe will either transmit when I dont want it to or it will not do it at all. Please make the instant transmission it's own button., you could put it under the rising rush button or even above the cards .

The game is great, graphics are also very good. I only have a problem with the energy limit of 10, if you could change this to 100 or something that would be great, it is a time waster having to skip 10 x 10 times to get the things you want. If you changed this I would definitely give this a 5 stars. Other than that, maybe add a "shop" where you could buy character fragments with zeni, the cost would depend on how rare the character is. All in this is a great game, thanks

Legends is amazing with a great, standard DB story. I love the variety of characters and the multiples of characters from certain storylines. The gameplay feels like it has improved, which has made it even easier to enjoy the game. Shallot, and his entourage, make the story quite enjoyable. I do hope some old enemies may be brought back at some point, but maybe in the other side for the story, like a twist, just to mix it up a bit.

Fantastic Game but it's missing some things. So I've played this game since the first day it came out and it grow everyday just makes me feel happy l. The graphics and the gameplay are 10/10 the fact that they added a character named "Shallot" is a great idea as we get a interesting character. But not every game is perfect. First I am going to say that sometimes when I am Ina battle and I accidentally press the rising rush button and then after you pressed that button you can't go back, which is REALLY annoying same happens with the strike attack button, etc. I also want to say that the rising rush is broken, for example When I pick 3 characters in the game and I do the rising rush it does 400,000 damage (for example) but then if the two die and there's 1 left and I do the rising rush, It somehow manage to do 1,000,000 damage... This is a strange bug, glitch to the game and if it was meant to be like that I think its too unbalanced. But anyways the game still is a very awesome game. With very awesome game mechanics and fantastic graphics. Thanks for reading.

The game itself is pretty fun. The graphica are entertaining to look at, and the art for the cards are amazing. It also gives you one of the most top tier units at the very beginning. The game is also fairly free to play friendly. But, if you want to beat things such as challenge rush you absolutely need the battle bonus units. Along with this, you only have so many defensive options. It feels more like who can spam their moves first, not actual skill.

I've played almost all DBZ games this one is far from its other games in a bad way. While it is a good time killer, it lacks a lot of other cool elements as the other games. This game clearly exists solely to capitalize on the in app purchase scheme. The tutorial is very laborious. It would be cool to have a sandbox world like the others and character customization. Its not horrible but it's also not great. 3/5

Overall this is a good game, great mechanics and fun events. Two things are keeping this from a 5 star, the PvP matchmaking and glitching. Matchmaking can be very inaccurate to the point where I get matched with teams ranked 800-1200 above me which is crazy. Also, sometimes when I start a fight the screen just goes black and is unresponsive. The touch animation is still up but there's no loading bar, I've let it sit for 15 min one time and nothing happened still. Not huge but it is annoying.

Pretty good, but steep. I have been playing this game since it's inception, it has come a long way and made many great upgrades and changes. Although, it seems as though the summoning system has gotten to be a bit out of range for those of us who aren't willing to spend money. Which I have only to no avail :). Fun gameplay, pretty decent story although a bit drawn out. Cronos ought to be easier to come by for the players who are waiting on every event to gather more!

It's a good game. But I'm writing this for one reason, and it's a bug I keep running into. I play this game while my phone is in the best possible conditions. Full charge, notifications off, all other apps closed, etc... and for no apparent reason, the game will just crash. This is a problem. It also seems to happen at the worst possible times. Once, I finished a Ranked Match and won, and right before the results showed up, it crashed and I lost for quitting. This needs to be fixed. NOW.

I've been playing this game almost from Day One, and my biggest fear came true: there isn't anything to do anymore. The devs give us almost no new content and not a single new game mode, and PvP still sucks and isn't worth the trouble. Instead of new content, we just keep getting new banners with new characters. The game has become a summoning simulator, with massive power creep, and we barely get any crystals as rewards or achievements. It still has excellent graphics and dynamic and interesting combat. But it feels empty. Worth a try for sure if you like DB, but I wouldn't spend any cash on it.

Good game for those that are fans of the show. It can be overwhelming considering how much there is to upgrade etc. I personally uninstalled the game because I hate having to replay a mission multiple times just to get all the requirements. I'm a person who has to fully complete a mission before I can move on to the next, but when it comes to the point where I have te replay 3 times just to 100% one mission I am out. Good game though.

Great gameplay and amazing visuals! Probably my favorite Dragon Ball mobile game, if not my favorite mobile game in general. However, it is very hard not to spend money and find this game appealing. Character pull rates are abysmal sometimes. Some are locked behind tickets you can only get by spending money to pull enough times to get them. Not a problem for me, but yeah. 5 stars easy.

Changed my rating to a 3 from a 5. This game has a serious issue with cheaters in the pvp system, it is to a point that it is unbearable when the opponent stuffs your rising attack consistently, not 1, not 2, not 3, not 4 times. It is to a point that you can tell they have a mod. I'm really close to uninstalling. Also, will you freaking fix the fights when your opponent has slow internet, like come on, just boot them

Ok so my review, this game is really fun. ive been playing sence first release and never stopped. i did have a few issues though, like the game kept crashing and it got really annoying. to fix that go to settings and turn off "Energy Saving Mode" when done it runs so much faster and smoother. so please if you are a DBZ fan try the game, its really fun and you wont waste your time playing it.

It is unplayable. Everything in game was going fine, I got some good characters, did a few chapters and was really enjoying the game when I got "an error has occurred" message. I got retry and return to main screen but nothing changes and I get looped back to the error message. Tried restarting the game and my phone. Tried it on and off of wifi. Nothing works.

This is still one the best games on mobile I would no competition in term of anime games. But it's not without its flaws lately it takes a very long time to get a new arc in the storyline and you no longer add higher difficulties in the older arcs so the game can get stale. But its still an awesome game but I would really like to see you guys add ozaru in the duel matches even if it's a one time event or something and also duel characters like goku and vegeta as a single unit.

Update on opinion: game still plays quite well after 2 years, graphics are good, gameplay is simple and easy to play. However, the summoning rate is annoying. You have to waste over easily 120 bucks on crystals to have a "decent chance" to pull the SP character you want. And the game feels it needs a way to harvest more crystals that doesnt require buying too many crystals or, make the Crystal's pricing bit more viable than 2k crystals for 40 bucks.

The first impression is stupendous! As a fan, I love the art style and interface. Just have to improve the script and storyline. Apart from that it's jammin! Keep up the good work! I need to see how much data I'm consuming though! PS I've stopped using this app since I prefer games like DBZ to be a hands on experience. Like an Action RPG Fighting Game. Xenoverse barely supports that preference but that's all I can put up with at the moment. I still maintain my 5 star rating though.

Dragon Ball is the greatest series to ever have been concieved. Excellent game with excellent graphics, though I wish it was a bit easier to get characters since 1000 Chrono Crystals is a bit costly for 10 random characters, I cannot purchase the Crystal packs with real money, security reasons being the foremost issue, so getting the crystals is quite difficult, but I might not be the only one with such a problem, many others may also have the same problem, other than that I have no qualms

This game has definitely improved since its release. Unfortunately, PvP still has its setbacks. They story is fun and interesting. You follow new characters through a rollercoaster storyline. There is plenty to do, and you are able to rebuff some of the older units through a process called zenkai awakening so they may keep up with the new characters. PvP is currently shutting down in middle of the preparation screen. It wouldn't be that bad, but you get penalized for disconnecting.

Ever since it's beginning, this game has really stepped up to be a great DragonBall mobile game. It's competitive but also with a great story and there's always something to do, characters are generally balanced out and with a little research you can build a great team. My only general gripe is the connection, PvP is so backwards because the connection makes it hard as hell to even land an attack sometimes and I get a communication error for no reason.

Excellent graphics and new story. I downgraded to 3 stars because all the connect issues I've had with playing Battle Royale today. and then the game was telling me I can no longer play today because it was the end of repeatedly. After I selected my players it just went into a connecting issue for like 10 or 15 minutes straight except they're waiting for the game to connect and it didn't and then to be told it was my fault didn't sit well with me so now I've missed out on medals for today.

I have been playing this game since it came out in 2018. The game itself is great but that's it I get to play. This third year anniversary messed everything up: drop rates are too low and no way to earn crystals unless you buy from the shop, the games crashes whenever it wants sometimes it freezes while it's loading on the title screen, freezes on pvp, raid battles, co ops and the regular story mode, why should I play the game or even download the app if it's going to freeze as soon as I open it

Just my personal experience. Started playing this a little after launch and it was fun but then the summoning got to be annoying by having a new banner but still getting mainly older characters... then I took a break for while and came but to see nothing has really changed in that department but as well as it feels like there is too much going on at one time and I noticed some things have changed in other areas as well, so honestly the only really enjoyable thing for me now is the storyline.

Awesome game great story,gameplay and graphics. However i hate stamina system having stamina for each character instead of a pool of stamina for all the characters would make it easier to keep playing the game. Also the new characters are great but hard to get them if you don't have a way to earn new crystals. Love the game keep up the good work.

The game is amazingly well built and animations are great, but there aren't many ways to get good characters, you can only get them from summon and to even attempt to get a good one you would need 1,000 chrono Crystal's, And the ways to get cc is story, Hoipoi coins but you have to summon 100 times and you only get 10-20 each time, and when you do try to summon there is a rare chance you'll get anything good. But overall great game but 4 stars.

I waited for this game since it was announced, i've spent hours and hours grinding it! After almost a year, with difficulties that you overcome, in a way or another, i can say that this game is by far a good title to play! Saying all that, you could improve a lot if you ll listen to constructive criticism! More storyline episodes!

After playing this game from the day it came out in June... this game has its ups and downs. I love the gameplay and it makes it fun and cool. But there is no content... there are not enough events, free to play units, too many re-runs with extremely old characters on new banners that are not good anymore. I support this game but if nothing changes then I don't know what the future lies for it.

I'd give it 5 stars if i didn't have to wait so long when I'm not connected to Wi-Fi It loads up faster for me most of the time now. it'd be sweet though if we could have our friends fight with us rather than only against us. perhaps i could pick two and they could pick one of their own or vice versa. Or i pick only 1 and two of my friends do the same when joining my team. sweet game though

the game can be super fun but the problem is that the game is mostly pay to win, without cc your technically finished and the fact that there are toxic characters plus getting shafted on summons makes this game less enjoyable

absolutely miserable. everything I've gotten as a free to play guy is always overthrown by some mf with a deep wallet and calling it a "cc glitch". PVP is way to full of people who have full teams of ultra's and I can never keep up. respectfully, I'm probably going to quit because everything I've worked for is basically useless. I do however enjoy the new vegito unit.

Super fun, great new story, and the list of characters makes every thing feel so unique! I could make a dream team of the universe's strongest or challenge myself with the weakest. Or try to recreate stories by only using characters that were present in that time so even if I have super saiyan goku vs vegeta I can't use him yet. Just love the way this game is set up.

This one was of best mobile games I've ever played. Only one is on its level, Dokkan battle. But now Zenkais have come and ruined everything. The Zenkais that have taken over the game are all very costly to get and even more costly because you need to use 7k Chrono crystals which now with the lack of events that provide resonable chrono crystals is extremely hard to get.

The game play is very good and the pvp is balanced to the point that when you play in the higher level the better player usually wins. But my main issue with the game is the summon rate of the sparking units, especially when you do a multi summon that costs usually $20ish. So if anything on the game needs fixing its the summon rates and maybe adding guaranteed sparkings when you buy 1000 or more crystals.

Smooth game play and good graphics. Still getting used to PvP but so far, no ragerts. 10/2/2019 Edit: Been playing for over a year now. Not many games can get me hooked like this! The events range from super easy to super hard. Well rounded. My only negative comment would be that it takes forever to load the game 😅 I still recommend it!

Amazing game for a mobile game. Keeps a lot of the same dynamics of old school DBZ games and costs very little battery. My pixel 2 xl doesn't even heat up at all while playing this game. I can run it for hours and it will still cost less battery than clash of clans for example. The controls for me sometimes don't register and it's really annoying. Especially online. I don't know if it's input page or just has to do with connection

I had to change from a 5 star rating. I mean I highly recommend this game. I have two knocks on it. One is the utter lack of balance between new and old characters. Which is to some extent understandable from the moneymaking aspect and in pvp can be overcome with skill. The big problem ... THE BIG PROBLEM is standby-ers. People who cheat using a poor connection. It absurdly benefits them over the player who's connection is stable. It doesnt happen at the lower half or the rankings and the top 1000 are supposed to be monitored, but in between, it is far FAR too prevalent. This is why I had to change to a 2 star rating even tho I love this game. If they ever fix this issue or even take note and make the attempt I would easily change back to a 5 star review.

It has good graphics,easy to play and at the beginning it's kind of easy to get the featured characters but after a while you dont really get that much luck. Tho Depending on how U play,Like,Say u spend a lot of money on tickets or chrono stones,Then You would have a higher chance of getting characters,Its hard to get sparkings in single summons but a little bit easier in consecutive. And I kinda wish they would add Ui goku and jiren And kefla

Game is fun and functional. However, the soul of the game is a loot box extravaganza. I can't begin to explain how bad the summons mechanic is. $21 for 2k crystals, which is the lowest. Then you try to summon the pulls you want and the algorithm in place makes sure the rate of what you want is . 0-something % while the least popular pull is literally at 80% draw rate. It's absolutely ridiculous. I would not recommend this game. The soul of it is wicked.

Love the game. A bit overwhelming at first because of the sheer number of characters, elemental types, and variety of tokens it can take a little time to figure out what all the different tokens do, which equipment to use, and how to rank people up. The combat is fun because of its simplicity and visually its very much representing dragon ball in a way that fans of the anime will enjoy. Love it.

Tons of characters from the iconic franchise, though me being a advent participant, I still have yet to gain some of the ones I really really want. That being said, I will delve into the times that I do play and continue to pursue, whatever may come. Do Your Worst....(Love the gameplay and the story is definately worth the mystery.) Can't wait to see what may come throughout the next anniversary!

it's a great game I see a few reviews about the game being buggy but I haven't encountered any problems for any new players it's battle system is simple also dont skip through the guide it tells you pretty much everything but it is hard to get the characters you want unless you invest some money into the game the menu is a bit complicated but play for a few days and you'll get the hang of it. the fights get very repetitive especially when you can easily Max out your main character.

gets borring fast. after 7years it culd get more batel options, not only ki blasr mele buff and special. we need more comat like duble in all stiles. doging need work, as if you get hit, you get all the card hits. and pvp its har to get a good batle, as 99% of players just stals out tha duel to get you in a combo you cant escape, so if you misclic for 1sec the mach is over.

Pretty fun game. Different type of fighting game, so enjoying it fully. Big DBZ fan so it's cool playing this game that is mixing the entire series up. You can tell the devs care about their audience, by the way the keep updating the game to continue to run smooth. Edit: The game is still holding up in 2021. Keeps getting better.

It gave me both for the new characters.But one of the characters did pop-up and I can't look it for a stupid pop-up.So if I don't get my character , i'm deleting this game because I just wasted how much c c for nothing

Awesome game; great graphics, better art. I wish the story was more developed at this point, but the continuous events give you something to always do. The login bonus events are fun. Very addicting as well. Can't wait until more characters become available, seems like only the tip of the iceberg at this point. I wish I had better luck with summons!

It is an amazing game. Ive spent hours of my time playing. I still love the game. The only criticism i can give is i have been playing with my friend who had started before me. He had gotten a jump start and because he already had half descent guys when i just started he was always ahead. I started to get some good charictors they still couldnt hold a candle to his. They would receive more damage and deal less damage than his guys. Impossible to catch up. Even if i play better i had no chance.

this game is absolutely amazing!! it's so fun and the events add a super fun experience! Each battle is intense and there is over 200 characters to use! If your worried it will take time to be good and get good characters, dont worry! It's super easy to level up your characters and most of the great characters can be used in ticket summons that dont use in game currency for money at all! This is by far the best and most amazing dragon ball game ever! And it stays true to the anime!

IT IS A FANTASTIC GAME. But i have one suggestion. The game is built in this way that most players have to play almost all day to achieve the rewards. This makes the game too addictive. The game is awesome for the most part. The only thing i feel it fails in is the real time pvp. The idea is great but the execution falls short, but its not the companies fault but an issue with connection speeds between the players and their mobile services providers. I'd personally opt for a ghost of other players parties if finding an opponent takes more then 10 secs.

okay straight up, no bs, been playing since day one and during it's time it had simple mechanics and amazing graphics, even though I miss playing with regular sparking units, I know they can't do much but support, so far I'm level 300 something, f2p and own more than half the ultra characters roster, and most legends limited, so yes it's possible to play without spending any money, does it require some grinding and time, yes it does, but at the end of the day, it's worth it.

Would give 5 stars as have been playing awhile but after the last few updates, loads perfectly fine, let's me get to battle setup then just before the battle starts it crashes. I have no idea why, I've got plenty of space, tried uninstalling and reinstalling, clearing cache, you name it, but still this problem is unresolved. I'm disappointed, this game is awesome. I loved the game, played it prior to launch and advanced a bunch, enjoyed it a lot... The drop rates on featured characters are so low as to require insane amounts of money to have a real chance at them. the price of the in game currency (crystals) is ridiculously high just so they can have it "sale" at a still ridiculous price. Great surprise! Was a little hesitant about this one but figured I would give it a shot. Ends up being a lot of fun. Keep on getting this bug where I do a consecutive summon and game softlocks in the loading or crash the game and when I go back into the game the crystals i used are gone and I don't get any characters. I can't believe how crisp the graphics are, how many characters, and how they each interact differently with each other...I haven't experienced lag. I've been on and off the game for a couple months now, but up until recently I've been playing the game actively. What I can say is that although I do enjoy the game as a whole, most of the mechanics and or systems in the game are not enjoyable. The equip rolling and awakening equip systems are some of the worst that I've seen, but the bonanza's do help. Getting cc is very unbearable, given you get so little rewards as soon as you get past beginner level areas, but the game is good. 9.5/10.

The game is fine but over the years it's gotten tough to play it and have fun anymore. I even considered trying to get a hacked version because the game has turned into a pay to win. You cant even get certain characters anymore without getting super chrono Crystal's which you cant even buy now. A perfect example is Goku DBL 15-05s. This is an absolute amazing game. It's fun, and it has an amazing story and free play. My one complaint is that I can never get the special summon characters, my luck is horrible and chrono crystals are difficult to get after completing the story. If there is an easier way to get crystals it would make it much more enjoyable

This game is the best game ever played but I think it will be better if there was a versus mode and if there were more God of destruction and even U.E Vegeta trust me this game would be the best but the only problem is they are always bringing new version and I hate it

Overall a great game I'd suggest putting some money into it so you can get a good feel for the game without getting frustrated. Easy to aquire in game characters and energy boosts. Graphics are pretty good, it feels like a console game on the phone and would definitely recommend the game if you enjoy DragonBall. One negative thing is that sometimes the servers mess up and the app force closes but it's a relatively new game so it'll get better with time

The game itself is fun however the drop rates are absolutely ridiculous. Yeah they give you free characters through events but they aren't that great. Get ready to drop some crazy amounts of money if you want to summon for anyone new. $17+tax is ridiculous for just one summon. The game doesn't give you enough cc to get the characters you want at all. Most cc is locked behind events where you have to use a new character or else it's almost impossible to beat.

I really like this game and how free I feel fighting other. But there are times where the game is hard to enjoy. One being that they are unforgivable with the summons, the rates are very small to get any good units or even ones on the banner. CC is how you summon for new characters, if you are new you'll be given a lot but if you have been playing for a while it's very hard to get cc. 3 Stars becoz it is very difficult to keep up with the game unless u spend money in the game. The game is trash everyone immediately had the new ultras because if you spend enough money you get it immediately, the NPCs have been having a glitch for me where they have unlimited ki + there's way to many cheaters the game used to be fun but now it's just pay to win like all the other games like it out there. it's fun, but the PVP is unbalanced and they don't know how to balance characters. But most of everything, or at least 90 percent of everything is behind a massive paywall. I really enjoyed playing the game but you have to invest so much time in as a free to play player and once you get to a point in the game getting cronos becomes almost impossible to farm once you've finished story in hard mode and all of the events I love to grind by there's a point where it becomes too much and I think that's what's killing the game for me... This game is REALLY FUN animations are smooth, Game modes are fun, and this is coming from a guy who knows little about dbz, theres ONE problem tho so im playing on a chromebook (no touchscreen tho) so its almost impossible to dodge attacks and all, so i feel like there should be full keyboard support because you CAN use H,J,K and L For the cards so i Feel as if you should be able to use the arrow keys to move, and THEN you could hold SPACE to dodge incoming attacks. I guess its true. When something is really good people will always seek something wrong with it. There is no arguing that this is a one of a kind game that has incredable amouts of work behind it. Wow... Genuinely the greatest mobile game I've ever played... EXTREMELY polished, satisfying to play, and rewarding! With some of the best loyalty systems I've ever seen in a mobile game! I love the game itself. A game for Dragon Ball Lovers!! Wether cannon characters or not it's fun to fight them. Very fun game! Amazing graphics, Smooth animations, epic fights and very easy to learn. Almost all main series fighters are available and not that hard to obtain either. Love the game! Most fun I've ever had on a mobile game. Fairly generous rewards. Gorgeous graphics and quick gameplay. The real world shop is very pricey. It's an overall decent game for Dragon Ball fans to kill time with. Only small issues here and there but bugs get handled by the support team rather quickly. Easily one of the best phone games I've ever played, they make it easy to grind for what you need instead of forcing you to pay for everything. Ppl are more than welcome to play freely. The game overall is very enjoyable, but every now and than gets stale until a new unit is released that I want to get or the story is added onto. By far one of the best DB games I've played. OMG! One of the best DBZ games I've played, especially on Android. Bandai Namco have outdone themselves with the gameplay, graphics, and presentation of this game. Looking forward to see where they take the game in the future and what other anime they might adapt to the framework of DB Legends.
