Very, disappointed at how this game has progressed. I thot you would have made an big impact in the community but, lately you have been doing the your jobs poorly but (I still believe that this game can get better) This is a list of things you could definitely improve 1. The giuld system 2. Higher drop rate when single summoning multiple times. I really love this game and played for about 2 years now but the lak of work put in to this is painful to watch😔

Easy to play hard to put down, controls are smooth. Heaps of characters and constantly updating them. Still a great game overall but its getting worse and worse. Drop rates for Special summons are bismal at best and its become pay to win. Would really like to see it go back to how it was. There are some PvP issies with lag but only experience them rarely myself. Have been playing this since day one and would like to see things get reverted to how they where. Fair and fun to play for all.

This has some of the worst connection issues I've ever dealt with. If the game has any trouble connecting to a server after finishing a stage, it will ask to reconnect, fail, and force you to start again from the title. Add to this how bad pvp connections can get and yeesh. On top of this, combat is janky and guessing based. It is almost impossible to react to attacks with how much delay actions have and once you lose momentum your opponent can roll through your character health. Disappointed :/

amazing game so far the tutorial alone gives you enough rewards to really get ahead start without having to shell out cash on micro transactions which is really refreshing in a era of "EA type" games for a free game this game is pretty damn amazing ! **Update** with the new updates rolling out they have nerf alot of the progression and it really makes a difference, it take alot more time to get the ball rolling in regards to leveling up. Training now takes 2-5x more uses which hurts progress

This is one of the worst mobile games ive ever come across, i started out last year n it was pretty alright, until recently the new "Huge update" rolled in, completely eliminating all the best or at least decent aspects of this game. Horrible experience, horrible gameplay, don't even waste your time getting it, u will be disappointed within a week when it's reality hits you.

This game was fun but something happened to my account and i was getting error codes. Customer service was unhelpful as I gave them all my log in info possible but they wanted my purchase date and i been playing for years so couldnt find that. It is very sad that all that time goes to waste. I hope this never happens to you. Time to delete this app.

I remember loving legends when it came out. It was pretty addictive, gave a lot of crono crystals (aka: the games currency), was extremely f2p (free to play) friendly, and overall was just a lot of fun. I cannot say that now however. With the addition of basically weekly zenkais, game breaking meta units, and overall imbalance with the game's pvp, its pretty much impossible to have fun anymore. Crono cystals are all dried up for the most as well. Honestly, just don't even bother.

Awesssooooommmmmmeee Game!!!!!!!!!!! Freaking good game for a dragon ball genre , yeah there are patience issues with the summons as repeating characters show up but the amount of dopamine u get after getting what you want is a must experience. Since a huge dragon Ball fan im crazy bout this "mobile game". A must in my life 🤩🤩

I found the story immersive and greatly expanding and the character customization was amazing. Just if you uninstalled it and reinstalled it from a new device there no sure fire way your gaining your hard earned characters back. That was what killed it for me after the third retry. But overall a amazing game, I love the fighting style. The pvp and how events are recurring so if you missed out on a character you always have a chance to get them again.

Graphics are good. Very good time killer. Sometimes in Daily missions, one of the mission would be to embark on an adventure but there would not be any adventure when we check..at this time how can we complete the daily mission ? Developer needs to work on this and it would be really nice if you guys can develop Dragon ball Legends Adventure game. Like The Amazing Spiderman or something else..where we can explore and experience the real Dragon ball universe and characters

The gameplay gets boring pretty quick, and the power creep in this game is unlike any other. The best part about this game for most players is the live pvp action, which is fun occasionally when its not lagging, BUT the fact that there are multiple units in the game that can kill you with just 3 or 4 cards (essentially 1 combo) is really not healthy for the game. It used to be slightly balanced when you had to meet requirements to increase a units damage, but new units always broken from start

I don't review or comment on games, but this game is truly atrocious. Missing inputs, a ton of lag, and very unbalanced characters. Also, this game features very scummy practices that just make you want to spend all your cash. The only good thing this game has going for it is being associated with the Dragonball franchise.

The game is interesting and has definitely come a long way since its release. Throughout the constant different metas and team builds also came excellent or fascinating storytelling through Story Mode which has you going through the life of Shallot, an Ancient Saiyan who has long since forgotten who he is and how he ended up in a different timeline. The game deals with a similar concept as Dokkan's Story Mode took regarding multiple timelines being all merged together and whatnot.

Being a dragon ball super fan, I love this game. The story is a good length, the character list is large and there's alot of side stuff to do. Plus with the consistent updates there's something new really often. I haven't had one problem with this game and I haven't had to spend a single penny to feel like I'm consistently progressing. I love this game!

The game is great, love the challenges and story but the one major problem is this game crashes so much. Crashes on summons, crashes on battles, crashed just to crash. I want you to fix this damned problem and i want a refund on all my tens of thousands of chrono crystals ive spent and never got a single damn thing out if it.

Good game. Loved the story. But it cheats you on 10 rolls because it isn't even guaranteed ONE sparkling i blew 20 for nothing😤😠😡👿 . On that note there needs to be more ways to dodge in general or at least give more characters super armor/ protection to some attacks and honestly more attack variety in general. If you could improve on these things the game would be better also make crystal rewards progressively increase please.

This game has become worse with time. It's just an Adventure grind simulator now and the payout is barely anything. Every game needs to make revenue that doesn't mean that you outright strip the game of free content as time goes on. Zenkai system is one such feature. It's basically character rebalancing but way worse in terms of completion of an unit. And even if you manage to finish the rigorous grind for 1 unit, its night and day difference when compared to the maxed out unit.

the game started amazing, but as it is now it's getting a PAY TO WIN game and I know that wasn't the intention (at least I hope). It would help a ton if the Chrono Crystals were a bit easier to get and don't mention the missions that are basically saying "Pass the EXACT SAME LEVEL more than 10 TIMES and you'll get ONLY 20 Chrono Crystal". What is the point of Spending a lot of time for Chronos for a new character that will eventually be reduced to trash when a new summoning event happens?

I've been playing Legends since the beta, and honeslty its the game I've played in a long while. It fights boredom and is an easy to use game. Its also child friendly with no gore or anything like that. The only problem is that the game sometimes never loads and stay on a black screen (rarely does that). Other than that I love this game!

I love this game, I've spent lots of hours on it but I wish they would add more ways to get cc (in game currency)once you beat everything. I know this is this games version of pay to win but I will never pay for a mobile game so I have stopped playing it. I would love to come back to it but it's pointless if I can't get any cc (in game currency). Not saying this game needs this feature but it would be awesome if we could trade characters between friends.

in game controls are kind of hard to get used to. but with enough tapping and smashing on the screen i manage to progress to the next round. the animations are sweet, the battles are what i would expect from a DBZ game for a free game im not bitching at all. it reminds me of a super upgraded version of DBZ Dokken but way way better. 4 stars only cause i think the motion mechanics could be smoother.

The combat is my only gripe with the game. In a number of aspects this game does mobile fighter some justice. Countless good ideas went into building this game with an art design that's gorgeous and character progression beyond mindless grinding. I never felt like I was losing because I didn't spend money and the comments suggesting such seem nonsensical. The reason I am uninstalling is that the game is an unplayable mess where it counts.

This game is fun and has a lot of characters and the story is good, but the difficulty curve is ridiculous in places. Some events go from not even needing to pay attention in one battle to being completely unable to win unless you have the exact right character at max power in the next. The story never gets that hard but if you want to actually experience the whole game you have to spend money to even come close

This game is amazing, the combat is simple yet difficult, the characters are uniquely made, and the story is well played out, the only problem are the summons, which can waste money, and the ultras are incredibly hard to get (not counting the free to play units) but other than that, it's WAY better then dokkom.

the only issue that I have with the game is that your prices they do not match up with how much they cost a couple your deals are not that reliable because I'm almost spending almost a hundred bucks for 6000 Chronos crystals when that should at least be 10K for how much I am paying when other apps charge cheaper for that certain price that's how you lose clientele not going to lie! beat the other people's prices

I really like this game. The story is fun, the summons are amazing to look at. Everything is awesome. But one thing that bothers me is the PVP. While it is fun, before I got most of my characters past the level 1000 limit, the times I got paired up with people that had all their characters at 1500 was several times. It would be great if depending on your level, you would get paired with someone that's also at your level.

I only have one problem with the game, its the percentages of obtaining characters. I've spent 6,000 gems on the anniversary summons... And got not a single one of the new characters! They have the higher percentage of obtaining them too. i guess its just my own luck😅. I just wish the consecutive summons had a guarantee 1 sparking character, but thats just me. My luck is nonexistent in the game lol. Other than that I don't have any problems with the actual game itself.

Editing my review. This game is cool. But when you get close to end-game. They literally stop carrying you. It's grind-out city. You will literally have to go through scraps upon scraps of crystals (the games currency) to either get the character you want or someone decent. In the beginning it's worth it, but it gets more stressful and annoying at the end.

Awesome game! Its pretty easy to get lots of items and prizes, but problem is that once you collect all dragon balls, you can only make one wish AND the options aren't so good. Espcially the option of having 1,000 Chrono Crystals. It makes more sense to at least have 100,000 Chrono Crystals or more.

Best Mobile Dragon Ball game. It has all of the sagas from the Anime (So no versions of characters from the Moro arc and up) And it's CC system (Currency for summons) Is pretty smart. The only problem is that after completing the main story campaign it gets a LOT harder to get CC and be able to sommon for the newest LFs and Ultras. Thats just about all the bad though, and it is very fun and intuitive to play.

I effin LOVE THIS GAME! WELL worth the wait! Keep the content coming! UPDATE (4/10/19): I've uninstalled this game. Went from feeling like fun to feeling like a cash grab thats all about the dollar, not enough about the players. Deteriorated summon rates, too few opportunities to get CC to handle new content, pvp bugs, cc prices, just to name a few....I long for the days when Legends was fun instead of a chore...may reinstall for Anniversary, but until then I have less frustrating things 2 do..

Poor controls, terrible unit upgrade systems that waste time and promote shelling out hundreds of dollars, and excessive RNG in the combat make this game terribly unfun in both PvP and PvE. Even with a good team and good play, you will constantly be shafted by forced rock paper scissors sections and random card drawing. For a good Dragonball Fighting Game experience, please try out FighterZ. Or if you'd like to stick to mobile games, try out Dokkan Battle for a more strategic PvE experience.

The game is fun you can unlock characters but it can get very annoying when your trying to get characters. And beacuse it takes a lot of cristals and it takes me an hour just to get that much just to do spin a bunch of times its a little hard to play because i play on chromebook but overall i love this game i play it everyday. Keep up the good work!

This game is so insanely wonderful that words cannot describe it, but there are some modifications that will make it literally sit on the throne of Dragon Ball games. Versus mod must be added so that we can play how we want and against any character we choose, determine the difficulty, and determine what the opponent's hp meter can be, so that the match can be longer and more enjoyable.

If you don't want to spend your lifetime on a tutorial and everytime you press a button it takes 5 seconds to connect to a server (you take literally a minute to get rewards of missions and events) then don't download it. It takes up like 5gb if you download all the data in high rez. Gameplay is good tho just can't be bothered waiting 5 minutes to play 20 seconds on autoplay.

This is a really awesome game! i think i got addicted to it. it's so much fun trying to get sparking characters. now, it does have problems i am worried about. 1: pvp bugs(they're funny most times but also annoying) 2: consecutive summon costs way too much. i think 700 gems is a good number to pay for. 3: it's hard to play this game without reception. because it ALWAYS have communication erros. beside, you should play this game if you love DB and want to relive it again!!!

To be honest, I'm always a bit bias on dragon ball games, since I'm a big big dbz fan, you can be trash or good, but when its actually good, my lord it's a wonderful thing to experience. One of the best gacha games by far, to be able to experience the 3d graphics and the fight style which each and individual character is mind blowing, theres a bit of a lag issue tho in rated pvp. Edit: Recent outlook onto the past few years of this game. My rating went from 5 to 3. Game is okay now,I guess.

Incredibly fun. This game used to have issues that made it sometimes would feel like microtransactions were the only way to gain characters but that is no longer the case! You can aquire characters through simply playing featured quests or completing missions to either gain souls for the character or by gaining crystals from the missions and quests. I was always a fan but I really love the game now that it's changed for the better.

In awe... Graphics, gameplay, story, characters, levelling, speechless lol... Really love the game... Some things still getting used to but doesn't change the fact that I keep logging in to play every chance I'm not doing anything.. Just one thing would be nice in the story mode n other modes is a pause button during gameplay. Except for Co op obviously. Oh n wen will this server update be done? I hope our daily bonuses aren't affected, if they are I hope we'll be getting some rare freebies

Overall fantastic game, I love the graphics and the dynamics of the gameplay. The flow and interactions between characters are great. The PVP mode applys great challenge because your playing not only other people but people who are fantastic at the game. But there has been times where the game completely freezes and the only way to get it un freeze is to restart the app. Other than that everything is perfect.

The dream come true for a Dragon Ball fan. This is the epitome of mobile gaming. And I'm not talking about the genre, playing style or graphics & performance but rather about the sole purpose of it, which is: pure entertainment. Awesome gameplay, graphics & performance (even on a low spec mobile) but that's not even close to the best part: it's really ad free, no ads, nada. Only thing required is good internet connection for lag free gameplay in PvP/Co-Op mode. Thanks a lot Bandai Namco.

Very nice, great graphics and fun system. Frustrating to complete certain challenges that require multiple hits because as you go on, you end up with not a single character of low enough level not to kill on one hit. Also please for the love of all that is holy STOP GIVING US EVENTS ABOUT GOKU AND BROLLY. THERE ARE A BILLION OTHER INTERESTING CHARACTERS, including ones who don't even have a single card, but they keep adding versions of Goku and its unbelievably tiresome.

The people who made this game clearly have love for the series. The amount of detail is amazing to one like me who has followed Dragon Ball since I was a kid. The micro transactions are not super predatory. The graphics are awesome I really enjoy it as it hits all the nostalgia points. One drawback I have had was a frequent amount of freezing and game closures. That seems to have been resolved with the latest update.

Its such a good game! I recommend it to everyone. People say its too hard to earn chrono crystals but I believe not. This game supplies you with ways to earn them. If you try to complete all the side challanges on the story, for completing those and getting the first time reward and the z mission crystals for completing you can get up to 41 crystals! The only reason it may be slow to earn them is if you don't purposefully try. Thanks so much for this game and developers you have done a great job

The game is great with a wide variety of characters, a pvp mode, a co-op mode, and other amazing features. However, the game withholds information from the player in the early tutorial. They force you to grind out a long and tedious story mode to unlock the more advanced tutorials. At that point, you already know most of the mechanics in the game. In pvp, you are forced to play against laggy players. They often win because of lag beating out your vanish. The game could be much more optimized.

Awesome graphic,good story and best fighting moves were combined in one game. I first download this game with hesitation but it's been a year. Trust me it is really a stress buster and additive game . It is fest for all dragon Ball lovers around the world 🌎.But it need some structural issues like going back in game and data stability. So 4 star sorry db legend. ✌🏻

This game is good and I enjoy it but it does have a few draw backs. It can take a while to acquire characters since being f2p limits what you can do. Zenkai awakening that requires crystals is rather tedious and tiresome. Every SP character would most likely get one and a lot require crystals to actually partake in it. As f2p this limits growth and character acquisition as well. Co-op and pvp also have a tendency to lose connection resulting in automatic loss. Rather frustrating.

The reason why I am giving this give 2/5 is because of PvP. Sometimes PvP is unplayable and sometimes it is the smoothest thing out there. I lost so many battles because of "bad ping" even though I have a good connection. I think this has been a problem for so many people yet the devs aren't fixing it. If this continues I'll just uninstall the game and change my rating to 1/5.

Great game, I love everything about it. The art is spectacular, the mechanics are simple and fun. However, crystals arent the easiest to come by after you have done basically everything. The summons are still insanely difficult to get the character you want. The amount of crystals i spent to try and get LF goku black was insane. And i didnt even get him once. Zenki awakening is way to difficult and i have yet to max one out yet. Over all its an amazing game, but those are my only two problems.<3

I got this game at the start of the 3rd anniversary. its kept me entertained the whole time, the 1 mobile game id ever spend money on. I like all the variety, and different battle elements. its the best it gets when it comes to mobile dragon ball games (sorry dokkan) I really can only complain that sometimes its hard to consistently get chrono crystals, but besides that, def 10/10 game

Good game could use some tweaks. Should add friend requests after a PvP battle, add some daily levels where you can get training items and soul boost items. This way we can play other levels instead of the same ones over and over. I'm enjoying it and I'm sure there is more to come thanks.

DO NOT PLAY THIS. This game just wasted all of it potential. It used to be better but now you just get killed by just 1 character. NO FUN! Since the last 4 month the game balance went totally out of space. Playing this as small spender is the worst! All they do is whale catching now. All have left to say is: DO NOT PLAY THIS! unless you want to whale out and don't care about COMPLETELY wasting your money every 2 weeks for something that gets completely obsolet after 2-4 month. And full of bugs

It's great game with horrible drop rates! Only game I've played where you can spend 1000 diamonds and get all rare. So no discount on the 10 summon and you get nothing. I've spent over 7000 diamonds on the last 2 events to not get a single sparkling character! That's 70 summons to get nothing! I've played it since launch hopefully they add SSG to the master pack 3

Pretty fun experience especially during events, however the app can be spotty at times. The app timed out while I was doing a 10x summon and after waiting several minutes for it to load I restarted the app and it neither gave me a refund for my summon nor gave me the 10x people. I was at home on very stable internet, had predownloaded to help game load times even still froze up. Since the last update I've had issues with my daily mission completion being counted and not getting me the rewards.

Don't download. This is a money hungry game. I don't ever get the Top tier characters from summons no matter how much I try which makes it impossible to play to good events unless you spends hundreds of dollars a month. I always get wrecked in pvp. The game is fun at 1st but gets irritating when you can't do events that require the best characters or be competitive. Ive gave this game a shot for the last 3 yrs and im just done.

Updating my review playing this game since 2018. Cheating is still rampant in PvP, progress has been made but there's no real purpose to play this part of the game. In order to get characters it's going to cost you money. Chrono crystals are not cheap for one Playstation or Xbox game you can also pay for a thousand of these crystals and that gives you one chance to get a character. There's summoning remediation is not fair and waste of money. save your money and do not invest in this game

Absolutely love the game except for one thing. Fix your damn PVP, how is it that I can get stun locked and yet still have the option to evade but it never fing works! The rates for pulls are decent, but then again if you don't have any of the new characters you're absolutely screwed!! I wish the system was better at match making, I shouldn't be going against people that have been playing for almost a decade when I myself haven't even been playing for a year!

I honestly like this game, but I can't like it as much as I would want to. I've grinded so many times for different banners for years and haven't got a single character from them when the characters are actually strong. I only ever get the characters after they get nerfed and aren't strong anymore. I log on every day to do challenges and unlock more but I get nothing from it.

The best Dragon Ball game I've ever played on mobile. Been playing since release, and just a few issues. A grind to get the crystals for a summon, and the summon is RNG, which sucks especially for event summons. Pvp is kinda a mess, lags and glitches sometimes, and lots of whales, fun but can be annoying. It almost has a pay to win feel, but if you work for it, you can definitely get by without paying. Story is great, new events all the time, so always something to do. Never bored when I'm on.

Game is amazing overall. Playing PVP is a thrilling experience, however, most of the time people dont use wifi connection and it either lags or just stops working. The app sometimes just quits on its own. Also, i saved up 4 thousand crystal chromes. And since i got a new phone i had to transfer my data to the new phone, and lost all of my crystals. I worked hard for those. P!ssed me off , thats not fair.

After playing legends for a good amount I can confidently say that this is the best mobile dbz game. It has a great story with a wide variety of characters form all over the dragon ball franchise as well as constant updates so that you never lose interest. But I have only really run into one problem and that is when you are about to try your luck on a banner and the game randomly closes taking your chronos and not giving you anything in return so I hope legends can fix that.

This game is amazing! But there are still a few bugs that need to be fixed. There is a new bug that when I try and change my laguage, my screen freezes and doesn't give me the option to change it to English. I want this fixed quickly because I don't understand Japanese, and the game automatically changed to Japanese overnight and now I can't read a thing so I can't grind missions.

The game has alot of problems, but I love it. It honestly is my favorite mobile game on the market, making me as interested in it as I am a console game. But the problem is how hard it is to get CCs (The currency you use to summon units) when you start to get far into the game. I get it, it's a gacha game and is expected, though it is ALOT more forgiving than other games, I think they need a new unit upgrade system, make it similar to knights chronicle where you can consume lesser units for star

I have been playing this game for a long time and love it. Yes, it has its downsides being a "gocha game" but the fighting isnt half bad when theres no lag. I love the character swaping and animations. That being said, i was on iphone originally and recently got an s22 ultra. The amount of bugs on android every time this team releases a patch is unacceptable. The constant crashes and pvp penalties needs to be delt with ASAP. Nobody wants to wait 1 hr to play pvp due to dcs caused by YOUR patch.

Great game and graphics. Would rate a 5 but Ive only had the game about 3 weeks and have lost numerous crystals trying to multi summon. I play and I grind to obtain crystals and characters. Its a real bummer when the game crashes in the middle of a summon and your crystals are gone with no reward. Not to mention just to seek help on your loss they make you jump through hoops to put in a request. I really like the game but beware Im sure Im not the only one this had happened to.

While I do have fun playing by myself I've noticed that getting into the game after dropping it is frustratingly difficult. Zenkai and Adventure are new and oh my god I'd rather do anything else then that, not only is it ineffective but it's ungodly p2p. I've also noticed that the rates are dramatically low and it's frustrating to get through events without new characters meaning I spend so much time trying to grind that by the next challenge I've lost all items and steam to play.

Haven't gotten the full experience yet and this game could be a lot better with some simplification, but overall it's great. More than anything this game could use a shorter tutorial and an easier to understand menu so people could play quickly and easier so it's a lot less of a hassle to get your friends to play with you. If my friend was trying to get me to play this to play together I would have to take some time just to get accustomed, something like the clash of clans formula to learn from.

I really like the game played it before but i took a break i came back and wow its amazing but i would recommend that you added training thing not to get xp or money or anything but if and when u pull a new character you can go into battle without the opponent attacking you if you set it like that you can edit opponemts lvl,hp etc. I think that it woild really help people enjoy pvp more! Please consider this.

I love Dragon Ball Legends, and ever since the news of Akira's passing came, I have been playing nothing, but this game. However, I just upgraded to the Samsung Galaxy S24+, and now I can't even play this game for more than 3 minutes without it just randomly crashing at any given moment for no reason. Please just optimize the game for newer phone models. It's honestly getting annoying, but the rest is just golden. I definitely recommend it!

I absolutely love this game! It's amazing, nice, and everything else! I however have 2 critiques. The new characters they keep realseing is amazing yet hard to get. Understandable so I can't so much. However to get said characters you need Chrono crystals. And for the amount of things we can spend Chrono crystals on, their just needs to be a more faithful and easier way to get them. Story mode is a good way though can take a while, most other things are once daily.

This game is great. One issue is that some people lag more than your grandmas wifi which throws off your flow. Personally I have collected about half or so of the LL units, but only once. I still rank 40+.There are so many characters in the game, each from a different part of dragon ball. What I dont like though is getting matched with a person that has payed to win, or just has really good luck with their max level, full star, full zenkai, ss2 Gohan tryhard against a team your just trying out.

So far so good. Dragonball, good combat, good art, loving it thus far. 3 months...update to 1yr still completely obsessed with this game its the only game I play most days. Once you start to get your characters built up and some good equipment the content become much more enjoyable and pvp becomes a game of 50/50 like in most fighting games. All in all this is the best game I have played on mobile to this day. Hope this helps.

Great Game" I love Dragonball I'm addicted. I would reccomend this game to Dragonball lovers. Edit: It's abt 2 years later and I have a different feeling about the game. It's very pay to play now. It's very hard for new players to get go a good point in the game. It's darn near impossible for new players to pull the new units so that their pvp teams are relevant in the meta. Also zenkai units are now pretty common in the game so it should be easier to get them fully zenkaied, but it's not.

My favorite game by far cause I am a die hard fan of Dragon Ball. I love it's experience of RPG PvP and it's amazing. The only issue is that it's getting higher and higher end so fast that now even with lowest settings and graphics i still experience constant framedrops on my vivo phone. I have been playing since the launch and it is OP, But the framedrops are annoying

I like the game and everything that it has but their is a few things that I don't like about it. And that's the skills bar I wish it was like the PS 2 where you have the attacks already set. And the only thing that you have to do is press any of the buttons on the controller. But on the phone for mobile app I wish you could just use the screen. Instead of pressing the skills below the dasher to attack your enemy so if they can make the changes that well be find cause I really like the game.

I have a lot of fun with the game, and I think it's a good "time waster". I do get some gripes for this. PVP mode, although it looks fun the first time, Everytime I want to use simple and not really good characters, I go against new sparking characters, 5* and with high gear. I've level up my characters I like and it's easy to get lvl 3000, but I feel that it's an "pay to win" and makes me feel my characters are worthless. Otherwise it's pretty fun and I can love the events and story By Forking

The Game is cool and is addicting🤩 Graphics are awesome and the controls are easy too! But the App Purchases are really overpriced, I mean wo buys 320 cc for 9,99€? That's really overpriced And the Units from Master Pack 1,2,3 shouldn't be in the new banners! THAT'S SO ANNOYING And if the game releases new characters, then we need to have the chance to grind atleast 2000cc from the events, not everyone can buy 2000cc for 50€😁

DB Legends has been one of my favourite smartphone games since release. Love the characters and the story. The pvp is also very fun to play around with, making all sorts of different teams and winning battles. Everything is all around amazing, all but one thing. I've joined this game at the start of the 5th anniversary, and even though there are older players out there with different opinions. Title: A Legendary Journey Unmatched - 5 Stars! Review: Dragon Ball Legends has captivated me since its release in 2018, and I can confidently say that it's an extraordinary game that continues to evolve and exceed expectations. As a loyal player for several years, I've witnessed the remarkable growth and constant updates that have made this game an absolute gem in the mobile gaming world. First and foremost, the gameplay mechanics are nothing short of sensational. The combat system is dynamic

PvE can be sometimes hard if you haven't pulled the newest units, but it's still not impossible Pay to play is an option, not too predatory. Only thing I'd change are the Ultra Rates, they're really REALLY bad and the 2000 Ultra Z-Power doesn't compensate the CC waste

Rather you not spend time on this game.

Some people might disagree, but I think this is the single best, most well-made app game ever uploaded to the Play Store. You can tell they've put a lot of thought into it. They grabbed a lot of criticism from Dokkan, another DragonBall game, and improved a lot of things. The interface is beautiful. The app is responsive, although a bit heavy on the storage (I'm currently at 1GB and I chose the Minimal Installation option, I'm Rank 40). The fighting system is pretty well built for a gacha game, the summons are super exciting, character variety is alright, although I'm sure they'll keep adding characters (at this time, for example, SSB Vegito, Goku Ultra Instinct, and a few others are missing). But there's still plenty to choose from for a viable team. You have about 5 or 6 top teams that are viable in PVP. The PVP itself is also really good in my opinion. Fast paced and exciting. I have an 80$ smartphone and I'm able to enjoy the battles with some minor input lag once in a while, so anyone with a better smartphone will probably face little to no problems with battles. Overall I'm super in love with this game so far.
